This perspective paper calls for a paradigm shift toward joint Spatial Representation Learning (SRL) in an unified embedding space that integrate raster perception with vector-based reasoning. Building on emerging efforts in multimodal geospatial learning, we highlight conceptual foundations, technical challenges, and promising directions for aligning heterogeneous spatial data sources. We contend that such integration is essential for developing next-generation geospatial AI systems capable of more accurate, interpretable, and semantically grounded understanding of the Earth.

</details>


### [196] [A Mathematical Conflict Framework for Contextual Data Modulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02381)
*Hakan Emre Kartal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于广义算子的数学冲突框架，将冲突定义为局部、方向性和上下文敏感的独立数学对象，而非优化过程中的隐式副产品。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法通常将冲突仅视为嵌入在优化过程中的隐式副作用，缺乏对冲突的独立、显式数学表达。本文旨在建立一个通用的、算子化的数学框架，以显式表示原始数据与上下文数据之间的结构差异。

Method: 提出了一种基于广义算子的数学冲突框架，将冲突视为局部、方向性和上下文敏感的量，整合了加权、尺度行为和输出映射等组件于统一的抽象算子之下。该框架不限于特定学习算法或优化方法，而是定义为可适应不同问题类别的通用结构。

Result: 该框架将冲突提升为独立的、基于算子的、组件级别的数学对象，而非优化过程中的隐式副产品，实现了对原始数据与上下文数据间结构差异的显式表征。

Conclusion: 该通用算子化框架为不同类别问题中的冲突建模提供了统一的理论基础，有望推动冲突分析与处理在更广泛场景中的应用。

Abstract: In this study, a generalized operator-based mathematical conflict framework is presented to explicitly represent structural discrepancies between raw data and contextual data. The proposed structure treats conflict as a local, directional, and context-sensitive quantity, integrating components such as weighting, scale behavior, and output mapping under a unified abstract operator. Without being reduced to a specific learning algorithm or optimization method, the framework is defined as a general structure adaptable to different classes of problems. While existing approaches typically treat conflict merely as an implicit side effect embedded within the optimization process, the proposed framework considers conflict as an independent, operator-based, and component-level mathematical object.

</details>


### [197] [AgentPLM: Agentic Protein Language Models with Reasoning-Augmented Decoding for Protein Sequence Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02386)
*Sahil Rahman,Maxx Richard Rahman*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AgentPLM通过将预训练蛋白质语言模型与推理增强解码（RAD）和对比智能体策略优化（CAPO）相结合，使PLM从被动预测转变为主动智能体，在酶设计、抗体优化、热稳定性等任务上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有PLM是被动预言机：前向生成时无法访问外部生物物理反馈，也无法在候选序列违反热力学或结构约束时重新调整生成方向。

Method: 提出AgentPLM，包含两个核心组件：1) 推理增强解码（RAD），在自回归生成过程中交替调用外部工具（ESMFold、FoldX、AutoDock Vina）；2) 对比智能体策略优化（CAPO），一种轨迹级别的直接偏好优化扩展，端到端训练策略以学习何时利用预言机反馈，而非单纯模仿高适应度序列。

Result: 在从头酶设计、抗体优化、热稳定性、蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用界面设计及零样本适应度预测任务上达到SOTA，抗体top-10%命中率相比最强被动基线有提升，并提供在线纠错的机制证据。

Conclusion: AgentPLM证明了将PLM与外部反馈机制结合的有效性，实现了无需显式回溯的在线错误修正。

Abstract: Protein language models (PLMs) are passive oracles: they generate sequences in a single forward pass with no mechanism to consult external biophysical feedback or redirect generation when a candidate violates thermodynamic or structural constraints. We introduce AgentPLM, which addresses this by equipping a pre-trained PLM with i) Reasoning-Augmented Decoding (RAD), which interleaves autoregressive generation with tool calls (ESMFold, FoldX, AutoDock Vina), and ii) Contrastive Agent Policy Optimisation (CAPO), a trajectory-level extension of direct preference optimisation that trains the policy end-to-end to learn when oracle feedback is informative rather than merely imitating high-fitness sequences. We evaluate AgentPLM on benchmark tasks spanning de novo enzyme design, antibody optimisation, thermostability, PPI interface design, and zero-shot fitness prediction with standardised oracle APIs and controlled sequence-identity splits. AgentPLM achieves state-of-the-art results with a gain in antibody top-10% hit rate over the strongest passive baseline, providing mechanistic evidence of online error correction without explicit backtracking.

</details>


### [198] [Bridging the Sim-to-Real Gap in Semiconductor Visual Program Synthesis via Input Binarization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02434)
*Yusuke Ohtsubo,Kota Dohi,Koichiro Yawata,Koki Takeshita,Tatsuya Sasaki*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了一种视觉程序合成框架，利用视觉语言模型将半导体电路SEM图像转化为可编辑的DSL代码，通过输入二值化策略弥合仿真-真实域差距，在MIIC数据集上将平均Dice系数从0.4393提升至0.5256。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 半导体检测需要精确的电路几何参数控制，但获取足够的真实训练数据成本高昂。现有的生成模型（如扩散模型、GAN）无法保证纳米级几何精度，亟需一种既能生成训练数据又能精确控制几何参数的方法。

Method: 提出视觉程序合成框架：1）使用VLM将检测图像转换为可编辑的DSL代码，描述电路几何结构；2）VLM仅在合成DSL渲染数据上训练；3）提出输入二值化策略，去除SEM特有的纹理和噪声，使模型聚焦于几何结构，弥合仿真到真实的域差距。

Result: 在MIIC数据集上，使用二值化输入相比原始输入基线，平均Dice系数从0.4393提升至0.5256，验证了简单的纹理抽象能有效缓解仿真到真实的域差距。

Conclusion: 通过视觉程序合成与输入二值化策略，实现了对真实SEM图像的几何结构解析，为半导体检测中的精确参数控制和低成本训练数据生成提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Precise parametric control over circuit geometry is essential for semiconductor inspection, yet obtaining sufficient real training data remains costly. Although generative models such as diffusion models and Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) can augment training data, they cannot guarantee the nanometer-scale geometric accuracy required for metrology tasks. We propose a visual program synthesis framework in which a Vision-Language Model (VLM) converts inspection images into editable Domain-Specific Language (DSL) code describing circuit geometries, enabling controlled generation of training data with exact parameter manipulation. Because the VLM is trained solely on synthetic DSL-rendered data, a domain gap arises when processing real Scanning Electron Microscope (SEM) images. We bridge this gap with an input binarization strategy that strips SEM-specific texture and noise, letting the model focus on geometric structure. On the MIIC dataset, binarized inputs improve the mean Dice coefficient from 0.4393 to 0.5256 over the raw-input baseline, demonstrating that simple texture abstraction substantially mitigates the sim-to-real gap.

</details>


### [199] [LLM-Evolved Pattern Generators for Optimal Classical Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02438)
*Windy Phung,Dominik Drexler,Arnaud Lequen,Jendrik Seipp*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出首个通过设计保证可采纳性的学习型领域相关启发式方法，利用LLM驱动的进化程序合成框架学习构建抽象（模式集合），并通过饱和成本划分可采纳地组合，在保持A*最优性保证的同时，实现了与最先进领域无关基线相当的问题覆盖率，且状态评估速度更快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习型启发式方法虽在满意规划中表现优异，但因其不可采纳性（无法保证启发值不超过真实代价），无法应用于最优经典规划。本文旨在填补这一空白，首次实现可采纳性由设计保证的学习型领域相关启发式方法。

Method: 不直接学习状态到启发值的映射，而是利用LLM驱动的进化程序合成框架，为每个领域学习一个程序，该程序能生成任意任务的模式集合（抽象），并通过饱和成本划分（saturated cost partitioning）将各模式产生的可采纳启发值进行可采纳组合。

Result: 学习到的程序编码了可解释的领域特定洞察，测试时运行开销可忽略不计；在多个领域上，其启发式方法达到了与最先进领域无关基线相当的问题覆盖率，同时每个状态评估速度显著更快。

Conclusion: 该方法首次实现了可采纳性由设计保证的学习型启发式，在保留A*最优性保证的前提下，兼具领域特定启发式的高效性和可解释性，为最优规划中学习型启发式方法开辟了新路径。

Abstract: Learned heuristics have recently become a competitive alternative to traditional domain-independent heuristics for satisficing planning. Existing approaches, however, focus on improving search guidance rather than guaranteeing admissibility, which makes them unsuitable for optimal classical planning. We present the first method for learning domain-dependent heuristics that are admissible by design and thus preserve the optimality guarantees of A* search. Instead of learning a direct mapping from states to heuristic values, we learn to construct abstractions that induce admissible heuristics. We use an LLM-driven evolutionary program-synthesis framework to obtain, for each domain, a program that produces a pattern collection for any task in that domain, and we combine the resulting patterns admissibly via saturated cost partitioning. Empirically, the learned programs encode interpretable domain-specific insights, run with negligible overhead at test time and yield heuristics that match the coverage of state-of-the-art domain-independent baselines on several domains while evaluating each state substantially faster.

</details>


### [200] [Food Noise & False Safety: A Systematic Evaluation of How LLMs Fail to Adapt to Eating Disorder Queries with Clinician Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02444)
*Giulia Pucci,Emily Hemendinger,Ruizhe Li,Gavin Abercrombie,Tanvi Dinkar,Arabella Sinclair*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究饮食障碍（ED）患者与大型语言模型（LLM）交互时存在的潜在危害，发现模型会不加批判地适应并促进不安全或自残性用户请求，特定语言线索会增加不安全回应的可能性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 饮食障碍患者越来越多地向LLM寻求指导、建议和情感支持，但这些系统并非设计用于提供临床建议，存在潜在风险。需要系统性地调查用户与LLM之间的有害互动模式。

Method: 与临床ED专家协商，识别提示中增加不安全回应可能性的特定语言线索；系统性地改变用户提示中潜在风险的程度，报告LLM不加批判地适应有问题的、潜在危险用户输入的程度。

Result: 发现特定语言线索会增加不安全回应的可能性；LLM会不加批判地适应并促进不安全或自残性用户请求。

Conclusion: LLM在缺乏适当安全机制的情况下，容易迎合ED患者的有害请求，存在加剧用户自伤行为的风险，需要加强对这类敏感交互的安全防护。

Abstract: Recent evidence shows that people with eating disorders (EDs) are increasingly seeking guidance, advice, and emotional support from Large Language Model (LLM)-based chat systems. Although these systems are not designed to provide clinical advice, their perceived expertise, neutrality and accessibility make them a frequent, albeit risky, source of support. This paper investigates potential patterns of interaction between users with EDs and LLMs, focusing on the potential harms arising from models that uncritically adapt to, and facilitate unsafe or self-harming user requests. We find, in consultation with clinical ED experts, that specific linguistic cues in prompts increase the likelihood of unsafe responses and, through systematically varying the degree of potential risk present in the user prompt, report the extent to which LLMs uncritically adapt to problematic, and potentially dangerous user inputs.

</details>


### [201] [HLL: Can Agents Cross Humanity's Last Line of Verification?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02449)
*Xinhao Song,Su Su,Sirui Song,Hongliang Wu,Wen Shen,Zhihua Wei,Gongshen Liu,Linfeng Zhang,Dongrui Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出HLL基准测试，用于评估多模态智能体在交互式CAPTCHA验证场景中能否通过类人交互突破人机验证边界。实验表明当前前沿智能体在真实界面条件下表现脆弱，在定位、动作校准、状态跟踪和过程一致性等方面存在明显缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多模态智能体被期望代替人类操作受保护的界面服务，但CAPTCHA作为专门防止自动化的验证机制，构成了关键的人机边界。现有评估缺乏对这一边界场景的系统测试，因此需要建立能够衡量智能体能否通过类人交互而非单纯识别来突破CAPTCHA验证的基准。

Method: 构建HLL（Humanity's Last Line of Verification）基准测试，涵盖多种交互式CAPTCHA类型，引入受控的现实主义压力因素（杂乱的网页、更难的任务变体、基于轨迹的条件验证），在闭环GUI环境中评估8个前沿多模态智能体。

Result: 当前智能体在人机替代边界上表现脆弱：性能在不同验证类型间差异显著，在真实界面条件下性能下降，当正确答案必须由有效动作轨迹支撑时性能进一步降低；在定位、动作校准、状态跟踪和过程一致性方面存在明显差距。

Conclusion: HLL为衡量多模态智能体在受保护的真实工作流中接近人类替代者的程度提供了具体测试平台，揭示了当前智能体尚无法可靠替代人类完成CAPTCHA验证任务。

Abstract: Multimodal agents are increasingly expected to operate interfaces on behalf of users, raising a central deployment question: can they truly substitute for humans in workflows that services deliberately protect against automation? CAPTCHA verification makes this question concrete. It is not merely a visual puzzle, but a human-verification boundary placed before account creation, content access, form submission, and other protected actions. We introduce \textbf{Humanity's Last Line of Verification (HLL)}, a controlled benchmark that uses interactive CAPTCHA verification to evaluate whether agents can cross this boundary through grounded, human-like interaction rather than recognition alone. HLL covers diverse CAPTCHA interactions and exposes agents to controlled realism stressors, including cluttered webpages, harder task variants, and trace-conditioned validation of the solving process. We evaluate eight frontier multimodal agents in a closed-loop GUI environment. The results show that current agents remain brittle at this human-substitution boundary: performance varies sharply across verification types, degrades under realistic interface conditions, and drops further when correct answers must be supported by valid action traces. By exposing gaps in localization, action calibration, state tracking, and process consistency, HLL provides a concrete testbed for measuring how close multimodal agents are to acting as human substitutes in protected real-world workflows. Our code is available at https://github.com/XinhaoS0101/HLL

</details>


### [202] [Beyond One-shot: AI Agents for Learning in Field Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02458)
*Junjie Luo,Ritu Agarwal,Gordon Gao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了工具增强的智能体AI能否自动从实验数据中学习并生成新干预措施。通过在医疗处方消息领域开展两阶段现场实验（共693,139次患者就诊），将"人类+聊天机器人"方法（第一阶段）与"工具增强智能体AI"方法（第二阶段）进行对比。AI方法配备分析工具、结构化DIKW推理智能体和透明证据链，生成的干预方案更优：最佳AI生成消息的点击率达69.8%（比基线高6.5个百分点）。关键发现是，价值来自领域特异性实验数据而非通用推理能力；前沿大语言模型在不使用实验数据时无法预测哪些干预措施会成功。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组织常规开展A/B测试实验，但实验数据未被充分利用以指导后续干预设计。从先验实验数据中提取可操作知识以指导新干预措施存在显著障碍。研究旨在探索工具增强的智能体AI能否自动从实验数据中学习并生成改进的干预措施，将行为实验从一次性评估转变为可累积设计学习的可扩展系统。

Method: 采用两阶段现场实验设计。第一阶段（人类+聊天机器人）：行为专家借助对话式AI共同设计13种消息变体（444,691次患者就诊）。第二阶段（工具增强智能体AI）：AI自主从第一阶段数据中提取原则，生成17种新变体（248,448次患者就诊）。AI方法配备了分析工具、结构化DIKW（数据-信息-知识-智慧）推理智能体和透明证据链。

Result: AI生成的最佳消息实现了69.8%的点击率，比基线高出6.5个百分点。前沿大语言模型在不使用实验数据的情况下无法预测哪些干预措施会成功。通用行为理论在特定医疗环境下并不统一适用。

Conclusion: 工具增强的AI能够从实验数据中学习并生成改进的领域相关干预措施，将行为实验从一次性评估转变为可扩展的累积设计学习系统。价值主要来自领域特异性实验数据而非通用推理能力。

Abstract: Organizations routinely run experiments for A/B testing, yet the data generated from one experiment is underutilized to inform subsequent intervention design. Significant barriers exist to extracting actionable knowledge from prior experimental data to inform new interventions. We study whether tool-augmented agentic AI can automatically learn from experimental data to generate new interventions in subsequent experiments. Through two-stage field experiments in healthcare prescription messaging (693,139 patient visits), we compare a Human + Chatbot method (Stage 1: behavioral experts with conversational AI co-designing 13 message variants, 444,691 patient visits) against a Tool-Augmented Agentic AI method (Stage 2: AI autonomously extracting principles from Stage 1 data to generate 17 new variants, 248,448 patient visits). The Agentic AI method, equipped with analytical tools, structured Data-Information-Knowledge-Wisdom (DIKW) reasoning agents, and transparent evidence chains, produces superior interventions: the best AI-generated message achieved a 69.8% CTR (+6.5 percentage points over baseline). Critically, our results suggest that the value comes from domain-specific experimental data, not from general reasoning ability: frontier LLMs operating without experimental data failed to predict which interventions would succeed. The field experiments also revealed that general-purpose behavioral theories used for intervention design do not extend uniformly to specific healthcare contexts, motivating an agentic AI approach to theory audits at field-experiment scale. Our research shows that tool-augmented AI can learn from experimental data and generate improved domain-relevant interventions, transforming behavioral experimentation from one-shot evaluation into a scalable system for cumulative design learning.

</details>


### [203] [AGENTCL: Toward Rigorous Evaluation of Continual Learning in Language Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02461)
*Yiheng Shu,Bernal Jiménez Gutiérrez,Saisri Padmaja Jonnalagedda,Yuguang Yao,Huan Sun,Yu Su*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了AgentCL评估框架，用于评测语言代理的持续学习能力，通过构建可复用任务流和记忆探测方法MemProbe，揭示了不同记忆设计在塑料性与稳定性之间的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准难以严格评估语言代理的持续学习能力：大多数工作聚焦于长上下文对话或文档的检索与推理，而近期终身适应基准常依赖简单的任务流，缺乏对跨任务关系的分析，导致难以理解代理随时间的学与复用行为。

Method: 提出AgentCL框架，通过构建可组合任务流（早期子解、证据或工作流可在后续任务中复用）与朴素任务流对比；同时开发MemProbe探测方法，存储交互、见解和技能并过滤不可靠经验。

Result: 在编码、深度研究和语言理解/推理任务上的实验表明：朴素流难以区分不同记忆设计，而受控流能更清晰地区分其塑料性；朴素和保留设置下增益有限且可能暴露记忆导致的退化。

Conclusion: 需要更强的记忆设计以平衡塑料性与稳定复用，当前方法在持续学习场景下仍存在显著局限。

Abstract: Language agents spend substantial inference time solving individual tasks, yet the experience acquired in one episode is often underutilized in future episodes. Continual learning expects an agent to accumulate reusable experience across a stream of tasks, improve over time, and avoid interference from irrelevant experiences. Unfortunately, existing benchmarks struggle to evaluate continual learning in language agents rigorously. Most efforts focus on retrieval and reasoning over long-context conversations or documents, while recent lifelong-adaptation benchmarks often rely on naive task streams with limited analysis of cross-task relationships, making it difficult to understand what an agent learns and reuses over time. This paper presents an evaluation framework AgentCL for continual learning in agents, centered on controlled task streams and metrics for transfer gains. AGENTCL constructs compositional streams where earlier sub-solutions, evidence, or workflows are intentionally reusable in later tasks, and contrasts them with naive streams where such reusability is not guaranteed. We use the benchmark to evaluate non-parametric memory designs for continual learning. To diagnose how memory design choices affect continual learning, we develop MemProbe, a probing method that stores interactions, insights, and skills, while filtering unreliable experiences during consolidation. Empirical analysis across coding, deep research, and language understanding/reasoning tasks shows that naive streams offer limited ability to distinguish memory designs, whereas controlled streams more clearly distinguish their plasticity. Meanwhile, naive and held-out settings often yield limited gains and can expose memory-induced degradation. These results highlight the need for stronger memory designs that balance plasticity and stable reuse.

</details>


### [204] [MCP-Persona: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Real-World Personal Applications via Environment Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02470)
*Wenhao Wang,Peizhi Niu,Gongyi Zou,Xiyuan Yang,Jingxing Wang,Haoting Shi,Yaxin Du,Jingyi Chai,Xianghe Pang,Shuo Tang,Yanfeng Wang,Siheng Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MCP-Persona是首个专为评估智能体在个性化MCP工具上表现设计的基准测试，涵盖Reddit、小红书、飞书、Slack等真实社交应用。实验表明现有SOTA智能体在个性化工具使用上存在显著困难。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准测试主要关注通用信息检索工具，无法捕捉个人社交应用中工具与个人账户或本地数据库交互带来的实际挑战，存在关键评估空白。

Method: 构建了包含多样化真实应用（Reddit、小红书、飞书、Slack等）的个性化MCP工具基准测试集，对多种SOTA智能体进行系统评估。

Result: 当前最先进的智能体在个性化工具使用任务上表现欠佳，暴露出显著的能力局限。

Conclusion: MCP-Persona填补了个性化MCP工具评估的空白，为识别和解决现有智能体在真实社交应用场景中的局限性提供了重要基准。

Abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) has emerged as a transformative standard for connecting large language models (LLMs) with external data sources and tools, and has been rapidly adopted across personal applications and development platforms. However, existing benchmarks predominantly focus on generic information-seeking tools and fail to capture the practical challenges posed by personal social applications, where tools interact with individual accounts or local databases. To bridge this critical gap, we introduce MCP-Persona, the first benchmark specifically designed for evaluating agent performance on real-world, personalized MCP tools. MCP-Persona encompasses a diverse set of widely-used applications, ranging from social media platforms like Reddit and Xiaohongshu (Rednote) to enterprise collaboration suites such as Lark (Feishu) and Slack. Our extensive experiments on various state-of-the-art (SOTA) agents demonstrate their significant struggles with personalized tool use, thereby highlighting the benchmark's crucial role in identifying and addressing these limitations. MCP-Persona is publicly available at https://github.com/wwh0411/MCP-Persona}{https://github.com/wwh0411/MCP-Persona.

</details>


### [205] [Iteris: Agentic Research Loops for Computational Mathematics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02484)
*Leheng Chen,Zihao Liu,Wanyi He,Bin Dong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向计算数学开放问题的智能体研究系统Iteris，并在两个Simons研讨会开放问题上成功应用，分别生成了共轭梯度法与随机坐标下降法在幂律谱上的渐近比较相图和QR分解列主元法在低相干性下失败的反例，表明智能体系统可参与开放问题研究流程但人类验证仍不可或缺。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型和智能体AI在数学发现方面取得了显著进展，但计算数学中的开放问题（通常需要数值实验、对抗性构造和算法设计）受到的关注相对较少，现有研究多聚焦于竞赛级别问题或研究级猜想，缺乏针对计算数学开放问题的智能体系统。

Method: 提出Iteris智能体研究系统，将其应用于两个来自Simons Workshop（arXiv:2602.05394）的开放问题，系统生成数值证据、构造和证明草稿，经专家评审和修正后得到验证结果。

Result: 第一个结果为共轭梯度法与随机坐标下降法在幂律谱上的渐近比较相图；第二个结果为QR分解列主元法在低相干性下无法选取良态子矩阵的反例。

Conclusion: 智能体AI系统能够有意义地参与计算数学开放问题的研究工作流，但人类验证仍然至关重要。

Abstract: Recent advances in large language models and agentic AI systems have enabled significant progress in mathematical discovery, from solving competition problems to tackling research-level conjectures. However, open problems in computational mathematics have received comparatively less attention: research in this area often requires not only proofs but also numerical experimentation, adversarial constructions, and algorithm design. In this paper, we introduce an agentic research system, Iteris, designed for open problems in computational mathematics. We apply Iteris to two open problems from a recent Simons Workshop collection (arXiv:2602.05394). In these case studies, Iteris generated numerical evidence, constructions, and proof drafts that led, after expert review and correction, to verified results. The first result is a phase diagram for the asymptotic comparison between conjugate gradient and randomized coordinate descent on power-law spectra; the second is a counterexample showing that QR factorization with column pivoting can fail to select well-conditioned submatrices even under low coherence. These case studies suggest that agentic AI systems can participate meaningfully in research workflows for open problems in computational mathematics, while human validation remains essential.

</details>


### [206] [RASER: Recoverability-Aware Selective Escalation Router for Multi-Hop Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02488)
*Yuyang Li,Zihe Yan,Tobias Käfer*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: RASER是一种基于单次RAG和六个特征构建的廉价路由系统，能够智能判断多跳问答是否需要额外检索，在不进行额外LLM调用的情况下，将token消耗降至始终执行剪枝方法的41-49%，同时在F1分数上保持竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多跳问答系统通常对每个问题都使用昂贵的检索策略（如问题分解、多轮检索、桥接实体搜索），这些方法依赖重复的LLM调用，增加了额外的token成本。然而分析发现许多多跳问题通过单次RAG就能正确回答，因此对每个问题都进行额外检索是对预算的浪费。

Method: 提出RASER路由器家族：RASER-2在单次RAG和PRUNE（额外检索）之间做二选一决策；RASER-3在单次RAG、PRUNE和迭代检索IRCoT之间做三选一决策。两者均基于单次RAG输出的六个特征，无需额外的LLM调用来做路由决策。RASER-3还引入了显式的成本-准确率权衡机制。

Result: 在6个LLM和3个多跳QA基准上，RASER在F1分数上与SOTA基线保持竞争力，同时token消耗仅为始终执行PRUNE方法的41-49%，并低于迭代检索和分解检索基线。

Conclusion: RASER证明了通过轻量级、无额外LLM调用的路由机制，可以在多跳问答中实现成本与准确率之间的高效平衡，避免了不必要的检索开销。

Abstract: Multi-hop question-answering systems often use expensive retrieval on every question. They may decompose the question, run several retrieval rounds, or search through bridge entities before answering. All of these strategies rely on repeated LLM calls to rewrite or decompose the question, which increases extra token cost, and it is not fitting when the LLM budget is tight. However, our analysis shows that lots of multi-hop questions are already answered correctly by a single one-shot RAG, so running an extra retrieval on every question wastes the budget. We introduce RASER (Recoverability-Aware Selective Escalation Router), a family of cheap routers built on one-shot RAG and six features from it. RASER-2 decides whether to stop or escalate to the extra-retrieval action PRUNE. RASER-3 chooses among one-shot RAG, PRUNE, and iterative retrieval IRCoT, using the same features but adding an explicit cost-accuracy trade-off. Neither router makes an extra LLM call to decide. Across six LLMs and three multi-hop QA benchmarks, both routers stay competitive with the other state-of-the-art (SOTA) baselines in F1 while spending only 41-49% of always-prune's tokens and also less than the iterative and decomposition retrieval baselines.

</details>


### [207] [Bridging the Last Mile of Time Series Forecasting with LLM Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02497)
*Yuhua Liao,Zetian Wang,Qiangqiang Nie,Zhenhua Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"最后一英里预测"问题，并设计了一个基于LLM代理的框架，在统计预测模型之上整合业务上下文（如假期、活动、专家反馈等），通过工具调用、安全约束和记忆机制，将推理轨迹转化为可审计的预测修订，弥合统计预测与业务可用预测之间的差距。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实中的时间序列预测在统计基线之后，还需要根据非结构化业务上下文（假期效应、活动计划、外部事件、历史类比、专家反馈）进行修订才能用于决策，但这一关键步骤在现有文献中未被充分探索。

Method: 提出LLM代理框架，包含：(1)统一预测工作区；(2)工具调用检索上下文证据；(3)结构安全约束下的推理轨迹到显式预测修订的转化；(4)基于map-reduce的长程预测分解；(5)记忆库支持的事后反思。

Result: 通过真实案例研究展示了LLM代理能够桥接统计预测与业务可用预测之间的差距，系统具备可控性和可审计性。

Conclusion: LLM代理有效解决了统计预测到业务决策之间的"最后一英里"问题，将非结构化业务上下文整合到预测修订流程中，提升了预测的实用性和可审计性。

Abstract: Time series forecasting has advanced rapidly, especially with the emergence of foundation models that show strong zero-shot performance on numerical extrapolation. However, in real-world forecasting settings, a statistically plausible baseline is rarely the final forecast used in practice. Before a forecast becomes decision-ready, it often needs to be revised using weakly structured business context such as holiday effects, campaign plans, external events, historical analogs, and expert feedback. This practical stage remains underexplored in the forecasting literature. In this paper, we formulate this stage as the \textbf{last-mile forecasting} problem and present an LLM-agent framework that sits on top of a forecasting backbone. Our system maintains a unified forecast workspace, invokes tools to retrieve contextual evidence, and converts reasoning trajectories into explicit forecast revision actions under structural safety constraints. It also supports long-horizon forecasting through map-reduce-style decomposition and post-hoc reflection through a memory bank. The resulting system is designed to be controllable and auditable. Through real-world case studies, we show how LLM agents can bridge the gap between statistical prediction and business-ready forecasting.

</details>


### [208] [SafeSteer: Localized On-Policy Distillation for Efficient Safety Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02530)
*Hao Li,Jingkun An,Zijun Song,Pengyu Zhu,Rui Li,Hao Wang,Wendi Feng,Yesheng Liu,Lijun Li,Jin-Ge Yao,Lei Sha*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SafeSteer提出通过仅对安全token进行on-policy蒸馏来对齐LLM，避免了对通用能力的过度损害，仅需100个有害样本即可实现良好安全性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对齐方法在提升安全性的同时会损害通用能力（alignment tax），且依赖大量通用数据或辅助奖励模型，成本高昂。

Method: (1) 通过激活引导（activation steering）构建安全教师模型；(2) 设计安全token选择算法识别关键安全token；(3) 在训练时仅对这些token施加反向KL散度惩罚，保留通用能力。

Result: 在7个安全基准上表现优异，5个通用基准上性能损失极小；仅需100个有害样本（不到基线方法的1%），无需通用数据。

Conclusion: 安全特征在输出分布中本质稀疏，局部修改即可实现高效对齐，SafeSteer以极低代价实现了安全与通用能力的最佳权衡。

Abstract: Aligning Large Language Models (LLMs) with human values often degrades their general capabilities, termed the alignment tax. Existing methods mitigate this by balancing dual objectives, which heavily rely on massive general-purpose data or auxiliary reward models.
  In this paper, we argue that, because safety features are inherently sparse within the output distribution, alignment requires localized modifications rather than global trade-offs. To this end, we propose SafeSteer, which performs on-policy distillation confined to safety tokens. First, we construct a safety teacher via activation steering. Based on this teacher, we develop a safety token selection algorithm. Consequently, SafeSteer restricts the reverse KL penalty to these tokens during training to preserve general capabilities.
  Experimental results across diverse models show that our SafeSteer achieves a superior trade-off between safety and general capability compared with existing methods, attaining strong safety performance on seven safety benchmarks with only minimal degradation on five general capability benchmarks. Notably, SafeSteer requires only 100 harmful samples without using any general-purpose data, less than 1% of what previous baselines used, considerably reducing alignment cost. More details are on our project page at https://anjingkun.github.io/SafeSteer.

</details>


### [209] [Tracking the Behavioral Trajectories of Adapting Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02536)
*Jonah Leshin,Manish Shah,Ian Timmis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种通过文本嵌入空间中的方向来定义和测量智能体"特质"的方法论和框架。该方法在68个标记的技能文件差异对上，针对"寻求敏感数据的倾向"这一特质，实现了91.2%的符号分类准确率和ρ=0.82的斯皮尔曼秩相关系数。该特质评估被嵌入到一个更广泛的智能体间协议中，使一个智能体能够通过可信中介评估另一个智能体的技能文件更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 技能文件、记忆文件和行为配置文件等文本文件通过人工或智能体自身的编辑不断演化，直接决定智能体的未来行为。因此，需要一种能够量化测量这些文件变化所反映的智能体特质变化的方法。

Method: 将特质定义为文本嵌入模型嵌入空间中的方向；在标记的"之前"vs"之后"技能文件差异对上训练线性模型以学习特质向量；通过将任意技能编辑的嵌入差异投影到该特质向量上进行评分；将特质评估构建为智能体间协议，通过可信中介实现交叉评估。

Result: 在68个标记的技能文件差异对上，针对"寻求敏感数据的倾向"特质，符号分类准确率达91.2%，斯皮尔曼秩相关系数ρ=0.82（留一法交叉验证）。

Conclusion: 所提出的基于嵌入方向的特质测量方法能够有效量化智能体技能文件编辑所反映的行为特质变化，并可扩展为智能体间的可信评估协议。

Abstract: Text files such as skill files, memory files, and behavioral configuration files play a central role in defining how modern agents act. Through edits by humans or the agents themselves, these files may evolve over time, directly steering the agent's behavior in future interactions. We present a methodology and framework for measuring agent $traits$ by defining traits as directions in the embedding space of a text embedding model. We train a linear model on labeled "before" versus "after" skill file diffs to learn a trait vector, then score arbitrary skill edits by projecting their embedding diffs onto this vector. Evaluated on 68 labeled skill diff pairs for the trait of propensity to seek sensitive data, our method achieves 91.2% sign classification accuracy and a Spearman rank correlation of $ρ= 0.82$ under leave-one-out cross-validation. We build this trait evaluation into a broader agent-to-agent protocol that enables one agent to evaluate another's skill file updates through a trusted intermediary.

</details>


### [210] [ClinEnv: An Interactive Multi-Stage Long Horizon EHR Environment for Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02568)
*Yuxing Lu,Yushuhong Lin,Wenqi Shi,J. Ben Tamo,Xukai Zhao,Jinzhuo Wang,May Dongmei Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ClinEnv是一个交互式基准测试，通过纵向住院模拟评估LLM作为主治医师的表现，发现最强模型决策F1仅0.31，信息获取与决策质量严重脱节。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有静态基准无法评估LLM在临床实践中逐步收集信息、做出序列化不可逆决策的能力，而现有交互式医疗基准在评估维度上各有折衷。

Method: 将真实住院病例自动构建为有序决策阶段序列，在每个阶段模型需主动查询四个专业智能体后方可提交用药、操作和诊断决策，采用确定性本体匹配评分。

Result: 最强模型决策F1仅0.31；出院诊断恢复F1为0.51而管理行为F1仅0.17；信息获取质量与决策结果质量严重解耦；模型在后期阶段仍持续发出冗余查询。

Conclusion: ClinEnv揭示了结果导向评估无法发现的信息获取缺口，为评估LLM临床推理能力提供了更全面的交互式框架。

Abstract: Clinical practice is not the selection of an answer from enumerated options: a physician gathers heterogeneous information incrementally and commits to sequential, irreversible decisions under uncertainty. Static benchmarks cannot probe and existing interactive medical benchmarks each compromise on at least one of them. We present ClinEnv, an interactive benchmark that evaluates LLMs as attending physicians over real inpatient admissions under a paradigm we term Longitudinal Inpatient Simulation. Each case is automatically constructed into an ordered sequence of decision stages; at every stage the model must actively query four specialized agents before committing to medications, procedures, and diagnoses. ClinEnv scores both what the model decides, through deterministic ontology-grounded matching, and how it gathers information. Across seven models, the strongest reaches only 0.31 decision F1, and outcome quality is sharply decoupled from process quality. Difficulty concentrates in management decisions and later stages, where models recover discharge diagnoses far more reliably than management actions (0.51 vs. 0.17 F1) and continue to issue redundant queries as cases progress. ClinEnv makes this information-acquisition gap, invisible to outcome-only evaluation, directly measurable.

</details>


<div id='stat.ML'></div>

# stat.ML [[Back]](#toc)

### [211] [Interpreting FCDNNs via RG on Exponential Family](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00157)
*Fuzhou Gong,Zigeng Xia*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文通过将统计物理中的重正化群(RG)方法与深度神经网络(DNNs)的训练过程建立对应关系，并推广到连续输入数据情形（指数族分布），证明了训练后全连接DNNs特征层输出的特征参数与连续场RG方法下输入数据的特征参数的不动点等价，从而说明DNNs训练等价于RG计算，网络能像RG一样提取数据主要特征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 建立深度学习可解释性理论，通过统计物理中的重正化群方法与深度神经网络训练过程的对应关系，为DNN在真实数据上的卓越表现提供理论解释。

Method: 以一维Ising模型的输入数据为起点，将对应关系推广到连续输入数据（指数族分布）情形，通过理论证明当全连接DNNs参数在训练后达到最优值时，网络特征层输出的特征参数等于连续场RG方法下输入数据特征参数的不动点。

Result: 证明了训练过程后，全连接DNNs特征层输出的特征参数与连续场RG方法下输入数据特征参数的不动点相等。

Conclusion: DNNs的训练过程等价于对指数族分布数据的RG计算，网络能够像RG一样提取数据的主要特征；该等价关系进一步验证了所建立的对应框架，为DNN在真实数据上的优异性能提供了可解释性依据。

Abstract: We consider establishing the interpretability theory of deep learning through constructing a corresponding relationship between the renormalization group (RG) method in statistical physics and the training process of deep neural networks (DNNs). We have proved the constructed relationship using the one-dimensional Ising model as the input data. In this paper we generalize our results to the case of continuous input data, which is a necessary preparation for applying the corresponding framework to real-world data. To be representative, we consider a class of data distribution in the exponential family. We prove that when the parameters of fully connected (FC) DNNs achieve their optimal value after training, the characteristic parameters of the feature layer output of DNNs are equal to the fixed points of the characteristic parameters of input data under RG method for continuous fields. This conclusion shows that the training process of DNNs is equivalent to RG calculation on this kind of data and therefore the network can extract main features from the input data just like RG. Also, the equivalence further validates the correspondence framework we have established, providing an explanation for the outstanding performance of DNNs on real-world data.

</details>


### [212] [Out-of-Distribution generalization of quantile regression with heavy tailed inputs: an SVM approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00265)
*Baptiste Leroux,Clément Dombry,Anne Sabourin*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于支持向量机（SVM）的极端分位数回归框架，利用再生核希尔伯特空间处理高维非线性设置，通过角度特征刻画极端观测，在协变量分布尾部进行局部化学习，实现了可泛化的极值外推，并在多瑙河径流数据上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统分位数回归在协变量取极端大值时面临外推挑战，现有方法缺乏对高维非线性极端分位数回归的理论保障和统一框架。本文旨在建立一种结合统计学习与多元极值理论的可泛化方法，解决极端协变量条件下的分位数回归问题。

Method: 1) 基于规则变化假设，利用角度分量刻画极端观测；2) 最小化渐进条件风险，将学习过程定位在协变量分布的尾部；3) 构建SVM框架，采用再生核希尔伯特空间处理高维非线性场景；4) 支持无界响应变量，无需限制性变换。

Result: 在温和的正则性假设下建立了有限样本学习保证，并通过多瑙河径流数据的实证研究验证了方法的实际有效性。

Conclusion: 本文统一了统计学习与多元极值理论，为极端分位数回归提供了可计算且理论完备的外推方法，在高维非线性极端值预测任务中具有广阔应用前景。

Abstract: We study quantile regression in an extrapolation regime where the covariate takes unusually large values. Under regular variation assumptions, extreme observations can be effectively characterized through their angular components, enabling learning strategies that focus on the angle of the most extreme observations. This approach is formalized through the minimization of an asymptotic conditional risk that localizes learning in the tail of the covariate distribution.
  We propose a novel Support Vector Machine (SVM) framework for extreme quantile regression, leveraging reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces to handle high-dimensional and nonlinear settings. Our method also accommodates unbounded response variables and avoids restrictive transformations. We establish finite-sample learning guarantees under mild regularity assumptions.
  The proposed framework unifies ideas from statistical learning and multivariate extremes, providing a tractable and theoretically grounded approach to extrapolation. We complement our theoretical findings with an empirical study on river flow data from the Danube, demonstrating the practical relevance of our methods.

</details>


### [213] [Is Zero-Shot Super-Resolution Possible in Operator Learning?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00296)
*Unique Subedi,Ambuj Tewari*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了算子学习中零样本超分辨率的理论基础，发现即使输入函数在连续域上可用且真实算子为简单秩一线性算子时，该现象在信息论上也可能不可实现。同时将输出函数的Hölder光滑性识别为充分条件，并推导了泛化界，实验验证了失效模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零样本超分辨率现象已被广泛实证观察到，但其理论基础尚不清晰，本文旨在填补这一理论空白，解释该现象何时成立、何时失效。

Method: 采用信息论与泛化理论分析：1) 构造反例证明零样本超分辨率在信息论上不可实现；2) 提出Hölder光滑性作为充分条件并推导泛化界；3) 实验验证理论识别的失效模式。

Result: 证明了即使在理想设置下零样本超分辨率也可能信息论不可实现；识别出输出函数的Hölder光滑性为其充分条件；实验证实了理论预测的失效场景。

Conclusion: 零样本超分辨率并非天然成立，其可行性依赖于输出函数的光滑性等条件，为算子学习的超分能力提供了理论界限。

Abstract: Neural operators are often reported to exhibit zero-shot super-resolution, a phenomenon in which a model trained on coarse grids produces accurate predictions on finer testing grids without additional retraining. Despite strong empirical evidence, the theoretical foundations of this phenomenon remain unclear. In this work, we provide a systematic theoretical study of zero-shot super-resolution in operator learning. We first show that zero-shot super-resolution can be information-theoretically impossible even in benign settings such as when the input functions are available over the entire continuum and the ground truth is a simple rank-one linear operator. We then identify H{\" o}lder smoothness of the output functions as a sufficient condition for zero-shot super-resolution and derive corresponding generalization bounds. Finally, we also validate the identified failure modes through experimental results.

</details>


### [214] [ERICA: Quantifying Replicability of Cluster Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00302)
*Siamak K. Sorooshyari,Manuel A. Rivas,Robert Tibshirani*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出ERICA框架，通过迭代聚类分配评估聚类结果的 replicability（可复现性），并在合成数据上验证有效，但在乳腺癌基因表达数据中发现非可复现结果，强调了严格检验的必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 聚类分析在科学中广泛应用，但缺乏定量评估聚类结果可复现性的统一框架，导致结果缺乏严格检验。

Method: 提出ERICA框架（Evaluating Replicability via Iterative Clustering Assignments），通过迭代聚类分配计算统计量，判断数据集是否存在稳定的结构，并辅以定量可视化方法分析簇间相似性和异常点。

Result: 在合成数据上，ERICA能够以可复现的方式发现聚类结构；但在三个乳腺癌基因表达数据集进行亚型验证时，出现了不可复现的结果。

Conclusion: 聚类结果需要严格的定量检验，ERICA提供了一个实用的检验工具，可用于识别聚类分析中的不可复现问题。

Abstract: Despite being ubiquitous in science, clustering remains a technique whose results are not quantitatively scrutinized via a framework. We present an analysis called evaluating replicability via iterative clustering assignments (ERICA) that is applied to a dataset to determine whether clusters are identified in a replicable manner. The pipeline computes a statistic that describes whether structure is found in a dataset. Quantitative visualization methods are presented to answer important questions such as the similarity between clusters, and the identity of points that may be outliers. When tested on synthetic data, the findings show clusters being discovered in a replicable manner. However, we note a possibility for non-replicable results when the pipeline is applied to three gene expression datasets for breast cancer subtype validation. The study underscores the need for rigorous inspection and offers a practical tool for doing so.

</details>


### [215] [Riemannian Stochastic Optimization for Sufficient Dimension Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00413)
*Thibault Pautrel,François Portier*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出SMAVE算法，结合Stiefel流形上的黎曼随机梯度上升与稀疏投影空间近邻定位，实现高效充分降维，在合成和真实数据上优于现有方法且运行时降低数个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于梯度的充分降维（SDR）方法存在维数灾难或每次外迭代计算成本至少为样本量的二次方的问题，需要更高效的算法。

Method: 将MAVE风险的经验准则重铸为Stiefel流形上的光滑最大化问题，导出闭合形式黎曼梯度；结合稀疏投影空间近邻定位与黎曼随机梯度上升（SMAVE算法）。

Result: 简化版几乎必然收敛，非渐近速率匹配标准非凸随机一阶方法；合成数据上SMAVE在中高维匹配或优于RMAVE，四个真实数据集上一致优于OPG，与RMAVE性能相当或更好，运行时降低数个数量级。

Conclusion: SMAVE在保持降维质量的同时大幅提升计算效率，是一种实用且可扩展的SDR方法。

Abstract: Sufficient dimension reduction (SDR) makes high-dimensional regression tractable by projecting the covariates onto a low-dimensional subspace that preserves the conditional mean of the response. Existing gradient-based estimators either operate in the ambient space and suffer from the curse of dimensionality, or localize in the reduced space at a per-outer-iteration cost at least quadratic in the sample size. We show that minimizers of the population Minimum Average Variance Estimation (MAVE) risk approximate the same Grassmannian target as the Outer Product of Gradients (OPG), and recast the empirical criterion as a smooth maximization on the Stiefel manifold with closed-form Riemannian gradient. The resulting algorithm, SMAVE, combines sparse projected-space nearest-neighbor localization with Riemannian stochastic gradient ascent. A simplified version comes with almost-sure convergence and a non-asymptotic rate matching the standard non-convex stochastic first-order scaling. Empirically, SMAVE matches or improves on RMAVE's synthetic subspace recovery at moderate-to-high ambient dimension, and on four real datasets it uniformly improves over OPG and is competitive with or outperforms RMAVE at orders of magnitude lower runtime.

</details>


### [216] [Parameter-Free and Group Conditional Online Conformal Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00419)
*Beepul Bharti,Ambar Pal,Jacopo Teneggi,Jeremias Sulam*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无参数的在线共形预测算法，用于在数据分布偏移的环境中实现组条件覆盖保证，兼顾了公平性和鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有在线共形预测方法在应对数据分布偏移时，难以同时满足组条件误差控制和无需学习率的参数无关实现，而这两者对公平性和鲁棒性至关重要。

Method: 提出一种无参数（parameter-free）的组条件在线共形预测算法，统一了组条件覆盖与无参数在线优化框架。

Result: 在合成数据和真实数据上，该方法不仅提升了现有无参数在线共形预测方法的可靠性，而且生成的预测区间大小与精心调参的组条件方法相当。

Conclusion: 该方法实现了最优的组条件覆盖保证，为分布偏移环境下的公平且鲁棒的不确定性量化奠定了基础。

Abstract: Uncertainty quantification (UQ) is critical for the deployment of machine learning predictors in real-world scenarios where the data distribution may shift over time (i.e., data may not be exchangeable). Online conformal prediction (OCP) methods address this issue at the expense of either (i) group-wise error control or (ii) learning-rate independent implementation. Group-conditional coverage is essential for fairness across different collections of data points and for providing finer UQ guarantees. Parameter-free optimization is crucial for robustness to adversarial and unknown data shifts. We propose a parameter-free algorithm for group-conditional OCP and demonstrate that it achieves the best group-conditional coverage guarantees.We evaluate our algorithm on synthetic and real-world data, demonstrating that our method not only improves the reliability of existing parameter-free OCP methods but also provides prediction intervals that are comparable in size to well-tuned group-conditional approaches. By unifying group-conditional coverage with parameter-free online algorithms, our work lays a foundation for fair and robust uncertainty quantification in shifting environments.

</details>


### [217] [Spectra-Guided Neural Tucker Factorization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00584)
*Fusheng Wang,Yikai Hou*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: SG-NTF是一种用于高维不完全张量补全的频谱引导神经塔克分解方法，通过连续频谱空间映射和时空协同门控机制，在保持参数效率的同时实现了竞争性的补全精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有高维不完全张量补全方法受限于离散表示的能力边界，难以有效捕获时间周期性等连续时空特征，因此需要一种能够突破离散表示限制的新方法。

Method: 将标量时间戳映射到连续谱空间以抽象时间周期性，同时引入时空协同门控机制通过乘法调制对时空上下文中的潜在交互进行显式滤波。

Result: 在真实世界的高维不完全张量数据上，SG-NTF在保持参数效率的同时维持了具有竞争力的补全精度。

Conclusion: SG-NTF通过连续谱空间映射和时空协同门控机制，有效平衡了补全精度与参数效率，为高维不完全张量补全提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: This paper proposes Spectra-Guided Neural Tucker Factorization (SG-NTF) for High-Dimensional and Incomplete (HDI) tensor completion. Circumventing discrete representational limits, SG-NTF maps scalar timestamps into a continuous spectral space to abstract temporal periodicities. Concurrently, a Spatio-Temporal Co-Gating (STCG) mechanism explicitly filters latent interactions via multiplicative modulation on spatiotemporal contexts. Evaluations on real-world HDI tensors verify that SG-NTF maintains competitive completion accuracy with parameter efficiency.

</details>


### [218] [Taming the Loss Landscape of PINNs with Noisy Feynman-Kac Supervision: Operator Preconditioning and Non-Asymptotic Error Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00643)
*Nathanael Tepakbong,Hanyu Hu,Chengyu Liu,Xiang Zhou*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出FK-PINNs方法，通过添加点数据保真项作为算子级预处理器，并结合Feynman-Kac表示生成监督标签，显著改善了标准PINNs在困难PDE上的病态损失景观问题，理论证明了条件数降低和非渐近误差界，实验验证了其在多种PDE问题上的优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准PINNs在求解困难偏微分方程时训练缓慢或无法收敛，这一问题被归因于底层微分算子导致的严重病态损失景观。现有方法难以有效缓解这一问题，需要一种理论上可控、实践上有效的预处理策略。

Method: (1) 在标准残差损失和边界损失基础上，添加少量点的数据保真项作为算子级预处理器，通过适当的权重保证条件数显著降低；(2) 对于具有Feynman-Kac表示的PDE，利用蒙特卡洛平均生成标签，称为FK-PINNs；(3) 使用过量风险分解方法推导tanh激活的神经网络经有限步梯度下降后的非渐近L²(Ω)误差界；(4) 建立了tanh神经网络一阶和二阶导数的伪维度界。

Result: 理论上证明了添加数据保真项后条件数显著小于标准PINN损失；推导了FK-PINNs的非渐近误差界；建立了tanh网络导数的伪维度界（独立贡献）。数值实验在Poisson、Schrödinger、平均退出时间和committor问题上验证了理论，FK-PINNs能成功求解标准PINNs严重失效的PDE。

Conclusion: FK-PINNs通过Feynman-Kac表示生成监督标签并作为算子级预处理器，有效解决了标准PINNs的病态损失景观问题，理论分析和数值实验均表明该方法在困难PDE求解上具有显著优势，伪维度界结果为神经网络理论提供了新工具。

Abstract: Physics-Informed Neural Networks (PINNs) often train slowly or fail to converge on challenging partial differential equations (PDEs), a behavior recently linked to severely ill-conditioned loss landscapes inherited from the underlying differential operator. We study PINNs augmented with a pointwise data-fidelity term, added at a few points in the domain to the standard residual and boundary losses. We show that this supervision term acts as an operator-level preconditioner: for suitable weights, our comparison bounds guarantee a substantially smaller condition number than under the standard PINN loss, independently of how the pointwise labels are obtained. For a broad class of PDEs admitting a Feynman-Kac (FK) representation, we generate such labels by Monte Carlo averages of the FK functional, resulting in what we call ``FK-PINNs", and using the excess risk decomposition approach, we derive non-asymptotic $L^2(Ω)$-error bounds for FK-PINNs with $\tanh$ activation trained by finitely many steps of gradient descent. Along the way, we establish pseudo-dimension bounds for first- and second-order derivatives of $\tanh$ neural networks, which are of independent interest and, to the best of our knowledge, new. Numerical experiments on Poisson, Schrödinger, mean exit time, and committor problems corroborate the theory, and show that FK-PINNs can successfully solve PDEs for which standard PINNs exhibit severe failure modes.

</details>


### [219] [On Median of Incomplete U-Statistics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00661)
*Nong Minh Hieu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文建立了不完全U统计量中位数（MIU）的有限样本集中速率，该统计量是一种用于对称核期望的高效稳健估计量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为不完全U统计量中位数提供严格的有限样本理论保证，填补其在集中速率分析上的空白。

Method: 通过推导MIU的有限样本集中速率，分析其作为对称核期望的稳健估计量的理论性质。

Result: 成功建立了MIU的有限样本集中速率，证明了其高效性和稳健性。

Conclusion: MIU是一种在有限样本下具有良好集中性质的稳健估计方法，适用于对称核期望的估计问题。

Abstract: We establish the finite-sample concentration rate for the Median-of-Incomplete-U-Statistics (MIU), an efficient robust estimator for the expectation of symmetric kernels.

</details>


### [220] [Statistical Testing on Directed Graphs by Surrogate Data Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00758)
*Chun Hei Michael Chan,Alexandre Cionca,Dimitri Van De Ville*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文将有向图上基于替代数据生成的统计假设检验非参数方法从无向图扩展到有向图。首先通过图移位算子的特征分解定义有向图的宽平稳信号，然后提出生成保持协方差结构的替代图信号框架，用于构建检验度量的零分布，最后通过示例和真实数据验证了方法的可行性与优越性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的基于替代数据生成的非参数统计假设检验方法主要针对无向图信号，尚未扩展到有向图场景。本文旨在弥补这一空白，将有向图中的平稳图信号概念与替代数据生成框架相结合。

Method: (1) 通过图移位算子的特征分解，定义有向图上的宽平稳信号；(2) 提出一种新的替代图信号生成框架，在平稳性假设下保持协方差结构；(3) 从替代信号中构建检验度量的零分布作为经验数据的参考。

Result: 通过引导性示例和真实数据应用，与现有的无向图方法及朴素置换方法进行对比，证明了所提框架的可行性和优越性。

Conclusion: 本文成功将有向图信号的统计假设检验非参数方法建立起来，提供的替代生成框架能够有效保持协方差结构，在实际应用中表现优于现有方法。

Abstract: In recent years, graph signal processing has emerged as a powerful framework at the intersection of signal processing and graph theory, providing tools for the analysis of signals defined on nodes while accounting for their relationships represented by edges. These tools have been successfully applied to various settings, including statistical hypothesis testing. In particular, non-parametric approaches based on surrogate generation have been proposed for signals on undirected graphs. However, they are yet to be extended to directed graphs. In this work, we first revisit the notion of stationary graph signals on directed graphs. Specifically, and through the eigendecomposition of the graph shift operator, we define directed graph wide-sense stationary signals. Then, we propose a new framework to generate surrogate graph signals that preserve covariance structure under stationarity assumptions. Null distributions of the test metric can then be constructed from these surrogates and serve as a reference for the empirical data. Finally, we provide guiding examples and an application on real data, in which we compare the performance of our framework with existing techniques for undirected graphs or based on naive permutation, demonstrating feasibility and superiority of the proposed approach.

</details>


### [221] [Statistical Analysis of using the Shapley Value for Sensor Anomaly Localization with Accurate Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00867)
*Xubin Fang,Rick S. Blum*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文对基于Shapley值的传感器异常/攻击定位方法进行了理论统计分析，证明在独立传感器情况下，Shapley值优化异常检验等价于使用Shapley计算中单项的简化检验；在相关双传感器场景中两种检验存在本质差异，且在不同相关符号下性能各有优劣，两者结合可获得更优方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有研究建议使用Shapley值进行传感器异常/攻击定位，但缺乏对其性能的理论分析，本文旨在填补这一空白，提供首个理论统计分析。

Method: 采用数学定义的优化二元分类器计算Shapley值，通过理论证明和数值实验，对比Shapley值检验与单一项检验在独立和相关传感器观测下的误差概率和决策区域。

Result: 独立观测下两种检验等价；相关双传感器（双变量高斯/拉普拉斯分布、常量/高斯攻击）下两种检验决策区域和误差概率不同；在大相关幅度场景中，Shapley值检验在某些情况下严格劣于单项检验，在另一些情况下严格优于单项检验，取决于相关符号。

Conclusion: 这是首个对Shapley值定位方法的理论统计分析，两种方法可结合获得更优性能，应鼓励进一步研究。

Abstract: Recent publications have suggested using the Shap- ley value for sensor anomaly/attack localization. We study the performance of such an approach by using mathematically de- fined optimum binary classifiers in the Shapley value calculation. To judge localization performance, we study the ability of the Shapley value of a given sensor observation to determine if that observation is anomalous. First, we prove that for cases with independent sensor observations, an optimized anomaly test using the Shapley value is equivalent to an optimized lower-complexity anomaly test using a single term in the Shapley value calculation, yielding the exact same probability of error. For some popular dependent observation cases involving two sensors, including correlated bivariate Gaussian/Laplacian probability density functions and constant/Gaussian at- tacks/anomalies, we prove that these two tests are fundamentally different, yielding different decision regions and error probabil- ities. Further, we prove that the Shapley value test is sometimes strictly inferior to the other (single term in Shapley calculation) test in certain statistically dependent bivariate Gaussian scenarios with large correlation magnitude and additive attacks/anomalies, while it is strictly superior in others, depending on the sign of the correlation. One can combine these two approaches to obtain a strictly better approach in these cases. These results, which provide the first theoretical statistical analysis of Shapley-based localization, seem very interesting based on the wide acceptance of the Shapley value by many researchers and should encourage further research on this topic. Numerical results are provided which illustrate our findings.

</details>


### [222] [Bandit Simulation for Average Reward Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00913)
*Samya Praharaj,Chih-Yu Chang,Koulik Khamaru,Kelly W. Zhang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出BSI框架，通过拟合模拟器来推断自适应算法（如多臂老虎机）的平均奖励，并构建渐近有效的置信区间，无需重要性加权。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多臂老虎机算法在在线平台、临床试验等领域广泛应用，但对其性能进行有效统计推断仍是一个开放问题。标准统计方法因自适应数据违反i.i.d.假设而失效，现有自适应数据推断方法仅适用于不依赖数据收集算法的估计量。

Method: 提出Bandit Simulation for Inference (BSI)框架：从观测数据（on-policy或off-policy）拟合老虎机环境模拟器，利用模拟器估计任意评估策略（包括自适应黑箱算法）下的平均奖励，并通过模拟器参数的不确定性传播来构建置信区间，仅需对行为策略的弱探索假设。

Result: 理论证明BSI可生成渐近有效的置信区间，实验表明在标准off-policy评估方法失效的场景下，BSI能维持名义覆盖水平。

Conclusion: BSI为自适应算法的统计推断提供了一种新框架，避免了重要性加权，放宽了假设条件，在理论和实证上均有效。

Abstract: Multi-arm bandit algorithms are increasingly used in online platforms, clinical trials, and social science experiments, but valid statistical inference on their performance remains an open challenge. After deploying bandits, a natural question is whether one can construct a confidence interval for its mean reward and assess whether it reliably outperforms a baseline policy. The total reward achieved in any single bandit deployment is random, and deploying a bandit twice on the same population typically yields different reward trajectories due to stochastic rewards. Standard statistical inference methods cannot be used because bandit algorithms introduce complex dependencies in the collected data, which violate the i.i.d. assumption underlying many classical approaches. Moreover, existing inference methods for adaptively collected data only apply to estimands that do not depend on the data-collection algorithm (such as the mean reward under a fixed action). We propose Bandit Simulation for Inference (BSI), a framework that fits a simulator of the bandit environment from observed data--either on-policy or off-policy--and uses it to estimate the mean reward under any evaluation policy, including adaptive blackbox algorithms. BSI formally propagates uncertainty in the estimated simulator parameters into the confidence interval construction. Furthermore, for BSI to be valid, it requires only weak exploration assumptions on the behavior policy and avoids importance weighting. We prove that BSI yields asymptotically valid confidence intervals, and demonstrate empirically that it maintains nominal coverage in settings where standard off-policy evaluation methods fail.

</details>


### [223] [Efficient Synthetic Network Generation via Latent Embedding Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00934)
*Feifan Jiang,Yinan Bu,Shihao Wu,Gongjun Xu,Ji Zhu*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出 SyNGLER 框架，基于潜在空间网络模型实现高效合成网络生成，通过学习低维节点嵌入并构建无分布假设的生成器，在保留网络稀疏性和节点度异质性等特性的同时，显著降低计算开销，并提供理论保证和实证验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有黑盒网络生成方法容易过拟合观测数据，忽视网络结构特征，且在大规模场景下计算开销大，亟需一种既高效又能捕捉网络结构属性的合成网络生成方法。

Method: SyNGLER 首先通过潜在空间网络模型学习低维节点嵌入，然后基于这些嵌入构建无分布假设的生成器（可采样或重采样节点嵌入），最后利用潜在空间网络模型生成合成网络。

Result: 理论方面建立了真实与合成网络边分布之间距离的一致性结果；实证表明 SyNGLER 能高效生成网络，相比现有方法更好地保留网络矩和度分布等关键网络特性。

Conclusion: SyNGLER 通过潜在空间框架有效兼顾合成网络生成的效率与质量，是一种通用且高效的合成网络生成方法。

Abstract: Network data are ubiquitous across the social sciences, biology, and information systems. Generating realistic synthetic network data has broad applications from network simulation to scientific discovery. However, many existing black-box approaches for network generation tend to overfit observed data while overlooking characteristic network structure, and incur substantial computational overhead at scale. These practical challenges call for synthetic network generation methods that are both efficient and capable of capturing structural properties of networks. In this paper, we introduce Synthetic Network Generation via Latent Embedding Reconstruction (SyNGLER), a general and efficient framework for synthetic network generation that builds on latent space network models. Given an observed network, SyNGLER first learns low-dimensional latent node embeddings via a latent space network model and then reconstructs the latent space by building a distribution-free generator over these embeddings. For generation, SyNGLER first samples (or resamples) node embeddings from the generator in the latent space and then produces synthetic networks using the latent space network model. Through the latent space framework, SyNGLER preserves unique characteristics in networks such as sparsity and node degree heterogeneity, while allowing for efficient training with lower computational cost than many existing deep architectures. We provide theoretical guarantees by developing consistency results on the distance between the true and synthetic edge distributions. Empirical studies further demonstrate the effectiveness of SyNGLER, which efficiently produces networks that better preserve key network characteristics such as network moments and degree distributions compared with existing approaches. Code is available at https://github.com/FeifanJiang/syngler.

</details>


### [224] [Practical and Optimal Algorithm for Linear Contextual Bandits with Rare Parameter Updates](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.00984)
*Sanghoon Yu,Min-hwan Oh*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究线性上下文赌博机在参数稀疏更新场景下的最优算法，提出了两种仅需O(log log T)次参数更新的算法BLCE-G和BLCE，在达到极小极大最优遗憾的同时显著降低计算复杂度，并扩展至广义线性模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献中"严格批处理"方法常混淆参数更新频率与区间内上下文自适应性，实际应用中参数更新成本较高，亟需在极少量更新次数下仍能保持统计最优性的高效算法。

Method: 提出BLCE-G算法（静态调度下在大小K两种场景均达到极小极大最优遗憾）和BLCE算法（去除近G最优设计步骤，降低计算瓶颈），仅需O(log log T)次参数更新；进一步将稀疏更新和计算效率原则扩展到广义线性上下文赌博机。

Result: BLCE-G在小K和大K两种场景下同时达到极小极大最优遗憾（仅差多对数因子）；BLCE在保持统计最优性的同时实现了已知最优算法中最低的运行时复杂度；两种算法均仅需O(log log T)次参数更新。

Conclusion: 本文证明了在极稀疏参数更新（O(log log T)次）条件下仍能实现统计最优的遗憾界，且BLCE算法在计算效率上显著优于现有方法，为实际部署提供了理论与实践双重优势。

Abstract: We study linear contextual bandits under rare parameter updates: the learner may incorporate reward feedback into its parameter estimate only at a small number of update times, while still observing contexts online and selecting actions sequentially. This viewpoint clarifies a practical distinction that is often blurred in the literature: many "strictly batched" methods additionally restrict within-interval context adaptivity, meaning that the action rule inside an interval cannot depend on the sequence of realized contexts/actions in that interval (beyond the current round's context). For linear contextual bandits, we propose two practical algorithms with only $O(\log\log T)$ parameter updates. Our first algorithm BLCE-G attains minimax-optimal regret (up to polylogarithmic factors in $T$) simultaneously in both the small-$K$ and large-$K$ regimes under a static schedule. Our second algorithm BLCE removes the near G-optimal design step -- a dominant computational bottleneck in prior strictly batched static-grid methods -- yet preserves minimax-optimal regret and achieves the lowest known runtime complexity among optimal algorithms. We further extend these rare-update and computational principles to generalized linear contextual bandits. Overall, our results yield statistically optimal algorithms under $O(\log\log T)$ parameter updates that are also computationally efficient in practice.

</details>


### [225] [Efficient Approximation for Encoder--Decoder Neural Operators via Variation Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01244)
*Jia-Qi Yang,Lei Shi*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究编码器-解码器神经网络在算子学习中的理论保证，通过引入变差空间作为非线性算子的无限维结构类，建立了Bochner L^q范数下的逼近误差界，误差分解为输入编码误差、输出编码误差和N^{-1/2}量级的有限宽度逼近项，给出了超越一般Lipschitz或Fréchet可微算子类的代数逼近和学习速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有算子学习理论主要针对Lipschitz或Fréchet可微算子类，缺乏对更广泛非线性算子类的理论保证。受函数空间神经网络理论的启发，本文旨在为编码器-解码器神经网络的算子学习提供统一的逼近理论基础。

Method: 引入变差空间（variation space）作为非线性算子的无限维结构类，该空间通过输入输出空间上的向量值测度直接定义；利用编码器-解码器双层网络在Bochner L^q范数下进行逼近分析，将误差分解为输入编码误差、输出编码误差和有限宽度逼近项三部分。

Result: 建立了逼近误差界，其中有限宽度逼近项为O(N^{-1/2})，常数与输入输出编码维度无关；当输入输出编码误差呈多项式衰减时，可导出代数逼近和学习速率。

Conclusion: 本文为超越传统Lipschitz或Fréchet可微算子类的神经网络算子学习提供了理论保证，证明了编码器-解码器架构在变差空间类算子上的有效逼近能力。

Abstract: We study operator learning using encoder--decoder neural networks. Inspired by the function-space theory of neural networks, we introduce a variation space as an infinite-dimensional structural class for nonlinear operators. This space is defined through vector-valued measures directly on the input and output spaces. For operators in this space, we establish approximation bounds for encoder--decoder two-layer networks in the Bochner $L^q$ norm. The resulting error bound decomposes into the input encoding error, the output encoding error, and a finite-width approximation term of order $N^{-1/2}$, with a constant independent of the input and output encoding dimensions. When the input and output encoding errors decay polynomially in the encoding dimensions, these estimates yield algebraic approximation and learning rates. The results provide an theoretical guarantees for efficient neural operator learning beyond general Lipschitz or Fréchet differentiable operator classes.

</details>


### [226] [Distribution-free changepoint localization after sequential change detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01256)
*Aytijhya Saha,Aaditya Ramdas*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无分布假设的框架，用于在停止顺序变化检测程序后构建变化点的后检测置信集，这是首个具有有效后检测覆盖保证的通用无分布顺序变化点定位框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有的顺序变化检测方法（如共形测试鞅）虽然能检测分布变化，但无法对变化发生的时间进行推断；而过往的后检测推断工作均要求已知变化前后的分布类别。本文旨在无需任何分布假设的情况下实现变化点定位。

Method: 提出一种无分布框架，利用共形测试鞅构建后检测置信集；在正确检测的条件下建立有限样本覆盖保证；推导置信集条件期望规模的非渐近界；并在适当的渐近体系下证明该条件期望规模一致有界。

Result: 建立了条件于正确检测的有限样本覆盖保证；提供了置信集条件期望规模的非渐近界；在渐近条件下证明条件期望规模一致有界；在模拟和真实数据上展示了强实证性能。

Conclusion: 本文是首个无需分布假设的通用顺序变化点定位框架，具备有效的后检测覆盖保证，填补了该领域的空白。

Abstract: This paper introduces a distribution-free framework for constructing post-detection confidence sets for changepoints after stopping a sequential change detection procedure. It is well known that conformal test martingales can be used to sequentially detect changes in distribution, but by themselves provide no inference for the time at which a proclaimed change occurred. Past work on post-detection inference requires pre- and post-change classes of distributions to be known, but this paper accomplishes localization of the changepoint without any distributional assumptions. We establish finite-sample coverage guarantees (conditional on correct detection). We provide non-asymptotic bounds on the conditional expected size of the confidence sets. Under suitable asymptotic regimes, we proved that the conditional expected size of the confidence set remains uniformly bounded. and demonstrate strong empirical performance on simulated and real data. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first general distribution-free framework for sequential changepoint localization with a valid post-detection coverage guarantee.

</details>


### [227] [On the Uncertainty Quantification Ability of Tabular Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01427)
*Tyler R. Johnson,Kian Ben-Jacob,Nima Negarandeh,Oriol Vendrell-Gallart,Ramin Bostanabad*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文通过全面实证研究，比较了TabPFN（表格基础模型）与高斯过程（GP）在回归任务中的不确定性量化能力，发现两者存在显式先验与学习先验之间的重要权衡：TabPFN在复杂高维且数据充足的问题上表现优异，而GP在数据稀缺场景以及核函数与真实函数匹配时，预测精度和不确定性量化更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基础模型在跨任务泛化上取得了成功，但许多力学与计算科学的关键应用不仅需要准确预测，还需要可靠的不确定性量化（UQ）。本文旨在系统性研究表格基础模型在回归任务中的UQ能力。

Method: 通过全面的实证研究，在不同复杂度、不同数据集规模和输入维度的回归问题上，系统比较TabPFN与高斯过程（GP）的性能。所有GP均使用默认设置构建，与TabPFN v2.5进行公平对比。

Result: TabPFN在复杂高维且数据充足的问题上表现出极具竞争力的性能；GP在数据稀缺场景下预测精度和UQ表现更优；当所选核函数构成底层函数的良好先验时，GP性能显著超越TabPFN。

Conclusion: 显式先验（GP）与学习先验（TabPFN）之间存在重要权衡，两者在不同数据条件下各有优劣，为实际应用中模型选择提供了指导依据。

Abstract: Foundation models (FMs) have achieved substantial success in generalizing across tasks without problemspecific training or fine-tuning. However, many critical applications in mechanics and computational science require not only accurate predictions but also reliable uncertainty quantification (UQ). Herein we investigate the UQ capabilities of tabular FMs in regression tasks through a comprehensive empirical study comparing Tabular Prior-Data Fitted Networks (TabPFN) against Gaussian processes (GPs). We systematically evaluate these two methods across a host of regression problems with varying complexity, dataset sizes, and input dimensionalities. We use a default setting to build all the GPs and for a fair comparison against TabPFN v2.5. Our findings highlight an important trade-off between explicit and learned priors: while TabPFN achieves highly competitive performance for complex, high-dimensional problems with sufficient data, GPs often provide superior predictive accuracy and UQ in data-scarce settings. Moreover, when the chosen kernel constitutes a good prior for the underlying function, GP performance can substantially exceed that of TabPFN. Our results can be reproduced from https://github.com/kianswarehouse/GPvsPFN.

</details>


### [228] [Computation-Aware Kalman Filtering with Model Selection for Neural Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01468)
*JR Huml,Jonathan Wenger,John P. Cunningham*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了计算感知状态空间模型（CASSM），一种针对神经科学中试次少、神经元多的非平衡数据场景的贝叶斯方法。通过引入新型训练损失和优化方案，该方法在保持计算可行性的同时实现了模型选择，其性能可与数据需求大的深度网络相媲美，且不确定性校准显著优于先前的贝叶斯扩展方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 贝叶斯方法在单细胞神经记录动态潜变量建模中具有显式先验和不确定性建模优势，但现代大规模数据集使过参数化深度网络成为主流。现有后验近似方法存在近似误差，虽有工作通过计算不确定性来弥补该误差，但面临二次复杂度和固定超参数的局限。本文旨在扩展计算不确定性方法至模型选择，以实现大规模状态空间中的可处理推断。

Method: 提出CASSM框架，核心包括：（1）新型训练损失函数，将计算不确定性纳入优化目标；（2）配套优化方案，使得在大型状态空间中推理可行；（3）专门针对"规模非平衡"场景（试次数远少于记录神经元数）设计，兼顾贝叶斯方法的先验优势与深度网络的计算效率。

Result: 在合成数据和真实神经记录数据上，CASSM在试次少、神经元多的非平衡场景中，性能与数据需求高的深度网络相当，同时不确定性校准显著优于此前扩展贝叶斯方法的工作。实验结果还为神经科学研究者在给定数据集属性下选择动态潜变量模型提供了参考路线图。

Conclusion: CASSM成功弥合了贝叶斯方法与深度网络在计算效率和预测能力之间的差距，为大规模神经科学数据分析提供了一种兼具不确定性校准和计算可行性的解决方案，并为研究者根据数据特征选择合适模型提供了指导。

Abstract: Due to their explicit priors and ability to model uncertainty, Bayesian methods have played a major role in dynamical latent variable modeling of single-cell neural recordings. However, modern-sized datasets have made overparameterized deep networks the preferred methods of choice due to their predictive power and favorable computational scaling. While many posterior approximations exist, all incur approximation errors. Recent work accounts for this error in the form of computational uncertainty but comes at the cost of quadratic complexity and assumes fixed model hyperparameters. Here we extend this development to model selection, including a novel training loss and optimization scheme, which yields tractable inference in large state-spaces. We introduce a framework, the Computation-Aware State-Space Model (CASSM), specifically designed for the scale-imbalanced regime, where the number of trials is significantly lower than the number of recorded neurons. In this regime, for both synthetic and real data, we show that our method is competitive with data-hungry deep networks, with significantly improved uncertainty calibration over previous attempts to scale Bayesian methods. Our experiments provide a roadmap to neuroscience researchers in choosing from a host of potential dynamical latent variable models given key dataset properties and constraints.

</details>


### [229] [Self-Regulating Annealing in Heavy-Tailed Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01645)
*Keito Wakatsuki,Hideaki Shimazaki*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 针对重尾数据集，提出基于SDE的HTDM采样器，利用状态依赖扩散系数实现自适应退火机制，理论分析与实验验证其必要性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有扩散模型基于高斯分布假设，对重尾数据集的尾部保真度不足；HTDM虽用t分布替代高斯分布，但SDE采样尚未充分探索。

Method: 提出显式包含状态依赖扩散系数的SDE采样器，该系数自适应调制有效噪声尺度，自然实现自调节退火机制。

Result: 理论探究了该退火机制；实验验证了该采样器对重尾分布样本生成的必要性。

Conclusion: 状态依赖扩散系数是HTDM中实现重尾分布采样的关键组件。

Abstract: Diffusion models have emerged as a leading framework for deep generative modeling. While the standard Gaussian formulation is theoretically convenient, its suitability for heavy-tailed datasets remains unclear. To address this, heavy-tailed diffusion models (HTDMs) extend the standard formulation by replacing the Gaussian distribution with a Student's t-distribution, thereby improving tail fidelity on heavy-tailed datasets. Although stochastic differential equation (SDE)-based sampling is possible in HTDMs, it has not been fully explored. In this paper, we propose an SDE-based sampler for HTDMs that explicitly incorporates a state-dependent diffusion coefficient. This state dependence naturally induces a self-regulating annealing mechanism by adaptively modulating the effective noise scale. We theoretically explore this mechanism and experimentally verify its necessity for reproducing samples from a heavy-tailed distribution.

</details>


### [230] [Provable Data Scaling Law for Meta Learning via Complexity Minimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02008)
*Kazuto Fukuchi,Ryuichiro Hataya,Kota Matsui*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了复杂度最小化框架，从理论上证明预训练数据规模增加能降低下游样本复杂度，并通过实验验证了该框架的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有预训练理论框架无法解释预训练数据规模增加能降低下游样本复杂度这一关键经验现象。

Method: 引入复杂度最小化这一元表示学习框架，通过评估各领域最适下游模型复杂度并最小化跨源域的最坏情况复杂度来学习表示，并建立从预训练到下游回归的端到端理论分析。

Result: 理论证明少样本适应的错误率随元训练数据量增加而改善；实验表明将复杂度正则化融入现有元学习方法能持续提升下游样本效率。

Conclusion: 复杂度最小化框架成功从理论上刻画了预训练数据规模与下游样本复杂度之间的缩放行为，为理解预训练的有效性提供了新视角。

Abstract: Pre-training has become a fundamental paradigm in modern machine learning, with one of its key empirical benefits being reduced downstream sample complexity as the scale of pre-training data increases. However, existing theoretical frameworks for pre-training do not fully explain this phenomenon. In this paper, we introduce complexity minimization, a novel meta-representation learning framework designed to enable theoretical analysis of this scaling behavior, which learns representations by evaluating the downstream model complexity best suited to each domain and minimizing the worst-case such complexity across source domains. Our end-to-end theoretical analysis, spanning pre-training through downstream regression, shows that this framework provably captures this scaling behavior; in particular, we show that the error rate of few-shot adaptation improves as the amount of meta-training data grows. Empirically, we demonstrate that incorporating complexity regularization into existing meta-learning methods consistently improves downstream sample efficiency.

</details>


### [231] [Convex Distance Operator Transport: A Convex and Geometry-Preserving Formulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02047)
*Junhyoung Chung,Euijong Song,Won Hwa Kim,Gunwoong Park*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出CDOT（凸距离算子传输）框架，这是首个通过联合保持特征对应与内在几何结构来对齐异构域分布的凸最优传输方法。CDOT采用基于算子的正则化项，通过引入距离算子和条件期望算子来对齐聚合距离结构，增强对局部几何变化的鲁棒性。理论证明了CDOT差异是带属性紧度量测度空间上的有效伪度量，并通过色散间隙概念阐明了CDOT凸性与Gromov-Wasserstein非凸性之间的几何根源。在有限样本下推导了非渐近风险界，建立了Frank-Wolfe算法的风险一致性。实验在合成点云、脑连接组和图分类基准上优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有最优传输方法（如Gromov-Wasserstein）在异构域对齐时面临非凸优化问题，且缺乏对局部几何变化的鲁棒性。作者希望设计一个凸的最优传输框架，既能保持特征对应关系又能保留内在几何结构，同时从理论上解释凸性带来的优势。

Method: CDOT通过引入距离算子和条件期望算子构建基于算子的正则化项，对齐聚合距离结构；在带属性紧度量测度空间上定义差异度量；利用色散间隙概念理论刻画CDOT与GW的关系；采用全局收敛的Frank-Wolfe算法求解。

Result: 理论证明了CDOT差异是有效伪度量；推导了非渐近风险界和风险一致性；实验在合成点云、脑连接组和图分类基准上优于现有方法，表现更稳定可靠。

Conclusion: CDOT是首个凸的异构域最优传输框架，兼顾特征对应与几何结构保持，具有良好的理论性质和实际性能。

Abstract: We introduce Convex Distance Operator Transport (CDOT), the first convex optimal transport framework that aligns distributions across heterogeneous domains by jointly preserving feature correspondence and intrinsic geometric structure. Specifically, CDOT employs an operator-based regularization that aligns aggregated distance structures by introducing distance and conditional expectation operators. Consequently, the proposed regularization improves the robustness to local geometric variations. We further prove that the resulting CDOT discrepancy is a valid pseudometric on the space of attributed compact metric-measure spaces. In addition, we characterize the relationship between CDOT and Gromov--Wasserstein (GW) through a new notion of dispersion gap, formally elucidating the geometric source of non-convexity in GW compared to the convexity of CDOT. In the finite-sample regime, we derive a non-asymptotic risk bound decomposed into optimization and statistical errors, establishing risk consistency under a globally convergent Frank--Wolfe algorithm. Experiments on synthetic point clouds, brain connectomes, and graph classification benchmarks demonstrate better performance over existing methods, with stable and reliable behavior in practice.

</details>


### [232] [It does what it says on the tin: safe synthetic data from coarsened margins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02101)
*Gillian M Raab*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种合成数据生成方法，通过先定义并保护变量间关系（边际分布），再应用统计披露控制（如顶部/底部编码、合并小类别、修改小计数）确保数据安全，最后使用迭代比例拟合（IPF）算法生成合成数据。该方法具有透明性和无披露风险两大优势，并以1901年苏格兰人口普查数据为例进行演示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有合成数据方法存在两个问题：一是合成数据中的变量关系不透明，用户无法知道哪些原始关系被保留；二是可能存在披露风险。为解决这些问题，提出一种既能保证透明度又能确保无披露风险的合成数据生成方法。

Method: 首先定义并计算需要保留变量关系的边际分布；然后对每个边际分布应用统计披露控制（如顶部/底部编码、合并小类别、修改小计数），并将所有计数粗化为披露限制的倍数；最后使用调整后的边际分布通过迭代比例拟合（IPF）算法生成合成数据。

Result: 该方法生成的合成数据具有两个关键优势：透明度（用户知道原始数据中哪些变量关系被近似保留）和无披露风险（合成数据源自已通过披露风险评估的信息）。以1901年苏格兰人口普查数据为例，展示了具体的实践步骤。

Conclusion: 提出的合成数据方法通过先控制边际分布的披露风险再生成数据，有效结合了透明性和安全性，为统计机构提供了一种可靠的合成数据生成方案。

Abstract: This paper proposes a method of creating synthetic data (SD) that will have two important advantages for the user compared to other methods currently available. The first is transparency; unlike other methods, the person in receipt of the SD will know which of the relationships between variables in the original data will be approximately maintained in the SD. The second is a guarantee that the SD is derived from information that has already been judged to be free of disclosure risk. This is achieved by first defining and calculating the margins where relationships between variables will be maintained in the SD. Each margin will then be subject to statistical disclosure control (SDC) to the standards defined by the data custodian, e.g. top-coding and bottom-coding, combination of small categories and/or modifying small counts. Further adjustment of the curated margins is advised by coarsening all counts in the table to multiples of the disclosure limit. These adjusted margins are used to create SD by the Iterative Proportional Fitting (IPF) algorithm. The practical steps involved in creating such SD are illustrated using data from the 1901 Census of Scotland.

</details>


### [233] [Error Bounds for a Diffusion Model-Based Drift Estimator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02115)
*Ioar Casado-Telletxea,Omar Rivasplata*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文针对Tapia Costa等人(2026)提出的基于扩散模型的随机微分方程漂移估计方法，首次提供了理论保证，推导了时间平均均方误差的显式风险界，将风险分解为Euler-Maruyama离散化、得分/去噪近似、噪声初始化和采样方差四个部分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机微分方程中的参数估计是许多科学领域的重要统计问题。Tapia Costa等人(2026)提出了一种利用扩散模型进行漂移估计的新方法，实验效果良好，但其理论保证尚属空白。本文旨在填补这一理论缺口。

Method: 利用扩散模型理论中的技术，推导漂移估计器的时间平均均方误差的显式风险界，并将风险分解为四个组成部分：Euler-Maruyama离散化误差、得分/去噪近似误差、噪声初始化误差和采样方差。

Result: 得到了漂移估计器时间平均均方误差的显式风险界，揭示了不同超参数和误差源之间的权衡关系。

Conclusion: 本文填补了Tapia Costa等人(2026)方法在理论保证方面的空白，通过风险分解为理解该估计器的行为提供了理论依据。

Abstract: Parameter estimation in stochastic differential equations is a classical statistical problem of much importance in many scientific fields. Recent work of Tapia Costa et al. (2026) introduced a novel technique for estimating the drift when the diffusion parameter is known, using discrete samples from multiple trajectories. Their method treats drift estimation as a denoising problem, and leverages tools from (conditional) score-matching diffusion models. Although their experiments showed promising results across different drift classes, the question of theoretical guarantees for their estimator was left unanswered. In this note, we address this gap by exploiting techniques from diffusion model theory. More concretely, we derive an explicit risk bound for the time-averaged mean-squared error of said drift estimator. Our bound decomposes the risk into the (i) Euler-Maruyama discretization, (ii) score/denoiser approximation, (iii) noise initialization, and (iv) sampling variance, revealing the trade-offs between the different hyperparameters and sources of error in the estimator.

</details>


### [234] [ProbRes: Volatility Learning for Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02117)
*Tingting Wang,Yunyi Zhang,Benyou Wang*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 提出ProbRes，一种事后概率校准方法，通过显式学习波动率动态并重采样归一化残差来生成预测分布，适用于单变量/多变量时间序列，能有效处理异方差数据和非高斯误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在金融应用中，概率时间序列预测对量化未来观测的风险和不确定性需求日益增长，现有方法在处理异方差数据（波动率动态变化）时存在不足。

Method: 提出ProbRes，一种与架构无关的事后校准方法。训练阶段使用两个独立模块分别建模条件均值和条件波动率；推理阶段通过重采样归一化残差生成预测分布。

Result: 在合成和真实数据集上，ProbRes能准确捕捉预测分布并生成校准良好的预测区间；理论结果证明了方法的有效性。

Conclusion: ProbRes是一种通用的、鲁棒的概率时间序列校准方法，能有效处理异方差性和非高斯创新分布，适用于单变量和多变量场景。

Abstract: Probabilistic time series forecasting has attracted increasing attention in financial applications due to the need to quantify risk and uncertainty in future observations. We propose ProbRes, a post-hoc probabilistic calibration method that explicitly learns and incorporates volatility dynamics into probabilistic forecasting, enabling effective handling of heteroskedastic data. During training, ProbRes employs two architecture-agnostic modules to separately model the conditional mean and conditional volatility. At the inference stage, it generates predictive distributions by resampling normalized residuals. ProbRes is applicable to both univariate and multivariate time series and remains robust under a wide range of error distributions, including non-Gaussian innovations with conditional heteroskedasticity. Theoretical results demonstrate ProbRes's validity and experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets show that ProbRes accurately captures predictive distributions and produces well-calibrated prediction intervals.

</details>


### [235] [Bayesian meta-learning for modeling Alzheimer's disease progression](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02228)
*Clara Hoffmann,Nadja Klein*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文提出一种贝叶斯元学习器，用于预测阿尔茨海默病患者的疾病进展（轻度或重度），该模型利用个体历史MRI数据和疾病轨迹，在无需重新训练的情况下为新个体生成个性化预测分布，在ADNI真实数据上达到与单任务模型和确定性元学习器相当的性能，并在长期预测中显著更优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 阿尔茨海默病患者的疾病进展预测对个性化治疗至关重要，但传统统计回归模型和单任务神经网络难以处理个体观测数据稀疏（每人仅少量观测）且个体间存在相关性的问题，导致泛化能力差。元学习提供了一种无需重新训练即可动态预测分布并建模非线性关系的自然途径。

Method: 提出一种贝叶斯元学习器，在多个个体数据上训练，但根据每个个体的历史数据调整其预测性病程分布。模型在未见个体上无需重新训练即可预测，计算复杂度与历史观测数量呈线性关系。

Result: 在ADNI真实数据上，该模型性能与单任务模型和确定性元学习器相当，且在长期疾病进展预测中显著提升了性能。理论上保证相比确定性模型在长期预测中更少过度自信。

Conclusion: 贝叶斯元学习器能有效利用群体信息同时保持个体化预测能力，特别适用于长期疾病进展预测，解决了小样本个体下传统方法泛化差的问题。

Abstract: Predicting whether an individual with Alzheimer's disease will experience mild or severe disease progression is essential for personalized treatment. Typically, practitioners seek to predict the distribution of a discrete disease score, conditional on an individual's current MRI volume and their historical disease trajectory. Classical statistical regression models and single-task neural networks are not well-suited for this purpose because fitting separate models is infeasible (since each individual typically has few observations), while ignoring individual-level correlation leads to poor generalization. Meta-learning, in contrast, provides a natural avenue to dynamically predict distributions without retraining and model nonlinear relationships between the outcome and covariates. Motivated by this, we propose a Bayesian meta-learner that is trained on multiple individuals but tailors the predictive disease score distribution to each individual's historical data. Our model predicts on unseen individuals without retraining, scales linearly with the number of historical observations, and is guaranteed to be less overconfident when predicting long-term disease scores compared to its deterministic counterpart. On real-world data from the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative (ADNI) database, our model achieves performance competitive with both single-task models and deterministic meta-learners, while substantially improving performance when predicting long-term disease progression.

</details>


### [236] [Identifiable Markov Switching Models with Instantaneous Effects and Exponential Families](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.02231)
*Roel Hulsman,Carles Balsells-Rodas,Sara Magliacane*

Main category: stat.ML

TL;DR: 本文研究了非平稳时间序列中潜在状态区间的可辨识性问题，提出了FlowMSM框架，结合马尔可夫切换模型和因果发现方法，能够在非线性、非高斯动态及瞬时效应下识别潜在状态区间及其依赖的因果结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时序系统常呈现非平稳行为（如季节气候、糖尿病患者的血糖波动），现有方法在频繁状态切换、非线性非高斯动态及变量间瞬时效应存在的情况下，难以识别潜在状态区间及其因果结构。

Method: 建立了在指数族独立噪声、非线性滞后和瞬时效应、时序状态依赖下的潜在状态区间及状态依赖因果结构的可辨识性理论，并提出了FlowMSM框架（可与任意平稳因果发现方法配对）用于恢复状态依赖的因果结构。

Result: 在合成基准数据和金融经济学数据集上验证了FlowMSM在检测潜在状态区间和从非平稳时间序列中发现因果结构的有效性。

Conclusion: 提出的可辨识性理论推广了非时序混合因果模型，FlowMSM框架为实际非平稳时序数据中的区间检测和因果发现提供了有效解决方案。
