We identify and formalize the root cause as a generative-discriminative gap: LLM generation optimizes for fluent, plausible text, while contrastive learning demands strategic violations of relevance at the decision boundary. Our analysis reveals two compounding failure modes: discriminative-agnostic generation, where the LLM lacks an explicit model of query information needs and defaults to generic or topic-drifted text that provides no contrastive signal; and source-dependent shortcuts, where distributional artifacts enable the model to distinguish negatives by origin rather than relevance, causing gradient drift that actively corrupts optimization. To close this gap, we propose CausalNeg consisting of two main modules: (1) CoT-guided counterfactual perturbation for data construction: decomposes why a document satisfies a query into explicit information requirements, then surgically violates individual requirements to construct negatives with controlled, interpretable hardness. (2) Query-view entropy maximization during training: disperses generated negatives across the similarity spectrum, minimizing the mutual information between source identity and similarity scores to suppress shortcut exploitation. We make our code publicly available at https://github.com/mzhangzhicheng/CausalNeg.

</details>


### [422] [FAiT: Frequency-Aware Inverted Transformer for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01306)
*Peng He,Yao Liu,Yanglei Gan,Run Lin,Yuxiang Cai,Qiao Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FAiT提出了一种频率感知的倒置Transformer架构，通过倒置注意力机制构建互补高通分支以恢复被低通滤波衰减的高频信号，并引入动态时频调制模块自适应调整频谱子带能量，在多个基准上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer的自注意力机制本质上是低通滤波器，会平滑掉对局部突变至关重要的高频信号。现有频率增强方法依赖固定频谱基且采用序列级均匀调制，忽略了真实时间序列的频谱特性随时间演化的特性，无法捕捉细粒度时变动态。

Method: 1) 倒置注意力(Inverted Attention)：将注意力图解释为可学习的低通算子，并通过倒置注意力矩阵构建互补的高通分支来恢复衰减的瞬态信号；2) 动态时频调制(DTFM)：生成实例条件权重，自适应地重新校准频谱子带的能量，实现细粒度的多尺度模式控制。

Result: 在广泛使用的基准测试中，FAiT一致性地优于基于Transformer和频率增强的最先进基线，同时保持了计算效率。

Conclusion: 通过内部修正频谱偏置和动态时频调制，FAiT有效解决了Transformer在多变量时间序列预测中对高频信号衰减的问题，为时变频谱特征建模提供了新范式。

Abstract: While Transformer-based architectures have established themselves as a dominant paradigm in Multivariate Time Series Forecasting (MTSF), their core self-attention mechanism inherently functions as a low-pass filter, systematically smoothing out high-frequency signals vital for sharp local changes. Recent advancements have increasingly incorporated frequency-domain operations to address this bias, however, most existing designs rely on fixed spectral bases and apply sequence-wise (uniform) modulation, implicitly assuming a time-invariant frequency response. This overlooks a key property of real-world series that their spectral characteristics often evolve over time, making uniform modulation insufficient for capturing fine-grained temporal dynamics. To tackle these limitations, we propose FAiT, a Frequency-Aware inverted Transformer. Specifically, FAiT rectifies the spectral bias internally through Inverted Attention, which interprets the attention map as a learnable low-pass operator and constructs a dedicated complementary high-pass branch by inverting the attention matrix to recover attenuated transient signals. Furthermore, FAiT introduces Dynamic Temporal-Frequency Modulation (DTFM), which synthesizes instance-conditioned weights to adaptively re-calibrate the energy of spectral sub-bands, enabling fine-grained control over evolving multi-scale patterns. Extensive experiments on widely used benchmarks demonstrate that FAiT consistently outperforms state-of-the-art Transformer-based and frequency-enhanced baselines, while maintaining computational efficiency.

</details>


### [423] [Conditioned free-energy density of proteins using unbalanced solutions to constraint satisfaction problems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01329)
*Pratik Worah,Subhash Khot,Srinivasa Varadhan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将条件非均匀Curie-Weiss自旋哈密顿量的对数配分函数（自由能）计算转化为不平衡的2→1范数计算问题，并设计了一个多项式时间的SDP算法，同时给出了不平衡量的下界证明。在泛素蛋白上的应用表明，该框架能够从已知晶体结构出发，探索自由能景观中的替代主链构象，识别蛋白质的柔性区域，同时保留其天然二级结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 计算条件非均匀Curie-Weiss自旋系统的对数配分函数（自由能）在统计物理和蛋白质构象分析中具有重要理论意义和应用价值，但直接计算在计算上是困难的。为此，作者希望将该问题转化为一个更易处理的优化问题，并设计高效的算法。

Method: 将自由能计算转化为不平衡的2→1范数计算问题，并设计多项式时间半定规划（SDP）算法，给出不平衡量的下界证明。在蛋白质泛素上应用该框架，从已知晶体结构出发，探索自由能景观中的替代主链构象。

Result: 成功设计了一个多项式时间SDP算法用于自由能计算，并在泛素蛋白上验证了框架的有效性，能够识别蛋白质柔性区域同时保留天然二级结构。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了一个连接统计物理自由能计算与优化理论中范数计算的桥梁，为蛋白质构象分析提供了新的计算框架。

Abstract: We show that computing the log-partition function (free-energy) of conditioned inhomogeneous Curie--Weiss spin Hamiltonians reduces to an unbalanced $2 \to 1$ norm computation, and design a polynomial-time SDP algorithm for this problem with a lower bound proof for the amount of unbalance achieved. Applied to the protein Ubiquitin, the framework starts from a known crystal structure, explores alternative backbone conformations across the free-energy landscape, and identifies flexible regions of the protein while preserving its native secondary structure.

</details>


### [424] [FreqLite: A Lightweight Frequency-Decomposed Linear Model with Adaptive Reversible Normalization for Robust Long-Term Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01339)
*Mirza Samad Ahmed Baiga,Syeda Anshrah Gillani*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FreqLite 是一种超轻量级的频域分解线性预测器，通过可学习的无损谱滤波器将输入分解为多个频带并由各自线性头预测，同时引入自适应可逆实例归一化（A-RevIN）来应对非平稳性。在长期预测基准上，FreqLite 以更少的参数和计算资源超越了 PatchTST 等 Transformer 模型，且所有改进均具有统计显著性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 轻量级线性预测器在长期时序预测中表现出色，但存在两个局限：(1) RevIN 使用单一回顾统计量对整个预测 horizon 进行反归一化，在非平稳数据下不准确；(2) 时域趋势/季节分解依赖固定的非自适应滤波器。本文旨在解决这些问题。

Method: 提出 FreqLite，一个通道独立的频域分解线性预测器。核心组件包括：(1) 可学习的无损单位划分谱滤波器，将输入分解为多个频带，每个频带由独立的线性头预测，高频带保留并建模；(2) 自适应可逆实例归一化（A-RevIN），通过可学习的门机制根据非平稳程度自适应调整归一化强度，严格推广了 RevIN。

Result: 在标准长期预测基准上，FreqLite 是最优的轻量模型。在长回溯窗口（L=336）下，平均误差低于 PatchTST Transformer（0.3244 vs 0.3587 MSE），参数减少4倍，内存减少2.2倍，每轮训练时间减少2.2倍。配对 Wilcoxon 检验显示改进具有统计显著性（p < 1e-5）。A-RevIN 在 ILI 数据集上实现约5%的 MSE 降低，且在非平稳性增强时其门控值单调上升。

Conclusion: FreqLite 以极轻量级架构实现了超越复杂 Transformer 模型的预测性能，A-RevIN 有效解决了非平稳数据下的归一化问题。所有组件均可独立消融，且结果可在普通硬件上复现，验证了方法的实用性和有效性。

Abstract: Long-term time-series forecasting needs models that are accurate yet efficient enough for commodity hardware. Lightweight linear forecasters are remarkably strong in this regime, yet they leave two openings: reversible instance normalization (RevIN) de-normalizes the entire horizon with a single lookback statistic, which is inaccurate under non-stationarity, and time-domain trend/seasonal decomposition relies on a fixed, non-adaptive filter. We present FreqLite, an ultra-lightweight, channel-independent frequency-decomposed linear forecaster: a learnable, lossless, partition-of-unity spectral filter splits the input into bands that are forecast by per-band linear heads and, unlike low-pass-truncation approaches, the high-frequency band is retained and modeled. FreqLite is the best lightweight model on the standard long-term forecasting benchmarks and, at long lookback (L=336), attains a lower average error than a PatchTST Transformer (0.3244 vs. 0.3587 MSE) while using 4x fewer parameters, 2.2x less memory, and 2.2x less time per epoch on a single 4 GB laptop GPU; although modest in magnitude, its improvements are statistically significant under paired Wilcoxon tests across all matched cells (p < 1e-5). We further introduce Adaptive Reversible Instance Normalization (A-RevIN), a regime-adaptive reversible normalization that strictly generalizes RevIN (recovered exactly when its gate is closed), engages under non-stationarity, and reduces to RevIN without harm on stationary data. We validate this on both a real strongly non-stationary dataset (ILI, up to ~5% MSE reduction) and a controlled synthetic drift sweep in which A-RevIN's benefit and its learned gate both rise monotonically with injected non-stationarity. Every component is independently ablatable (Linear and RLinear are special cases of FreqLite), and all results are reproducible on commodity hardware.

</details>


### [425] [All Models are Wrong, Knowing Where is Useful: On Model Uncertainty in Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01363)
*Bernd Frauenknecht,Devdutt Subhasish,Artur Eisele,Friedrich Solowjow,Sebastian Trimpe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种通过针对性处理不确定性来有效缓解模型利用问题的概率模型框架，并展示了在真实硬件学习和安全探索方面的成功，讨论了不确定性感知的基于模型的强化学习的未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）在数据效率和安全性方面具有潜力，但学习到的动力学模型的不准确性常被智能体利用，严重阻碍了MBRL方法的能力。因此需要解决模型不准确带来的模型利用问题。

Method: 提出一个通过针对性处理不确定性来缓解模型利用问题的框架，使用概率模型来处理不确定性。

Result: 在真实硬件上直接学习和安全探索方面取得了成功。

Conclusion: 不确定性感知的MBRL能够有效缓解模型利用问题，在数据高效和安全的机器人学习方面具有潜力。

Abstract: Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) infers information about the environment from a learned dynamics model and bears the potential to address open problems such as data efficient and safe learning in robotics. However, inaccuracies of the learned dynamics model are typically exploited by the agent, substantially hampering the capabilities of MBRL methods. We present a framework for dealing with inaccuracies of probabilistic models through targeted handling of uncertainty that effectively mitigates model exploitation. We present recent successes in learning directly on hardware and safe exploration, and discuss future directions for uncertainty-aware MBRL.

</details>


### [426] [BRo-JEPA: Learning Modular Arithmetic in Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01372)
*Divyansh Jha,Yuanfang Xie,Varan Mehra,Brennen Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了神经网络能否学习抽象代数规则，通过在MNIST数字上施加模10算术运算，使用JEPA潜在世界模型。标准模型无法泛化到未见操作，而引入块旋转预测器（利用模10循环结构）后，ResNet-based JEPA模型实现了99.46%的零样本和 rollout 准确率，表明当架构匹配问题结构时，潜在世界模型可以学习符号变换规则。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究神经网络是否能够真正学习抽象的代数规则（如模运算），还是仅仅记忆训练模式，从而理解模型在符号推理任务上的泛化能力边界。

Method: 使用MNIST数字作为状态，模10算术运算作为动作，构建JEPA风格的潜在世界模型。对比标准监督基线、带加法运算嵌入的JEPA模型，以及引入块旋转预测器（block-rotation predictor）来强制在潜空间中编码模10的循环结构。

Result: 标准监督基线和带加法运算嵌入的JEPA模型只能拟合见过的运算，无法可靠外推到未见运算。而块旋转预测器实现了强零样本泛化，最佳ResNet-based JEPA块旋转模型达到99.46%零样本准确率和99.46% rollout准确率。

Conclusion: 当模型架构与问题的底层结构（如模运算的循环群结构）相匹配时，潜在世界模型能够学习并泛化符号变换规则，而非仅仅记忆训练数据中的模式。

Abstract: Can neural networks learn abstract algebraic rules, or do they merely memorize training patterns? We investigate this using MNIST digits as states and modular arithmetic operations as actions in a JEPA-style latent world model. Standard supervised baselines and JEPA models with additive operation embeddings fit seen operations but fail to extrapolate reliably to unseen ones. To bridge this gap, we introduce a block-rotation predictor that imposes the circular structure of modulo-10 arithmetic in latent space. This enables strong zero-shot generalization, with the best ResNet-based JEPA block-rotation model achieving 99.46\% zero-shot and 99.46\% rollout accuracy. Our results suggest that latent world models can learn symbolic transformation rules when architecture matches the structure of the problem. Our code can be \href{https://github.com/DL-World-Models/mnist-math}{accessed here}.

</details>


### [427] [From Performance to Viability: A Bootstrap Framework for Latent-Space Representation Learning in Adaptive Biological Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01374)
*Jacques Raynal,Pierre Slangen,Elsa Raynal,Jacques Margerit*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种用于适应性生物系统的潜在空间表示学习的引导框架，包含五个分析层级：可观测性能、动态组织、潜在组织、纵向生存能力和内部预测逼近。该框架通过三个步态-遮挡案例研究进行方法学说明，展示了当现有表示不足以解释适应性动态时，如何引入新的分析层次。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在适应性生物系统中，相似的表型表现可能源于不同的组织结构，且当前看似相似的配置可能遵循不同的纵向发展轨迹。这促使需要一种超越基于性能解释的方法论框架，而又不预先假设完整的机制模型。

Method: 提出了一个五层级的引导框架用于潜在空间表示学习：层级1可观测性能→层级2动态组织→层级3潜在组织→层级4纵向生存能力→层级5内部预测逼近。采用方法论和认识论意义上的"引导"策略，在当前表示不足以解释适应性动态时引入新的分析层次。

Result: 以三个已发表的步态-遮挡研究作为方法学案例序列（非新实验证据），形式化展示了性能分析如何引导出潜在组织，静态潜在组织如何引导出纵向生存能力，以及观测到的生存能力如何引导出内部预测逼近。

Conclusion: 该框架的贡献不在于新的学习算法、临床方案或数据集，而是一种描述适应性生物数据中，越来越具信息量的表示如何从观测不足中涌现的方法论框架。

Abstract: Observable performance is commonly used to characterize biological systems. In adaptive systems, however, similar performances may arise from distinct organizations, and configurations that appear comparable at a given time may follow different longitudinal trajectories. This limitation motivates a methodological framework for moving beyond performance-based interpretation without assuming a complete mechanistic model in advance. This article proposes a bootstrap framework for latent-space representation learning in adaptive biological systems. Here, bootstrap is used in a methodological and epistemological sense: new analytical levels are introduced when the preceding representation becomes insufficient to account for observed adaptive dynamics. The framework is organized around five levels: observable performance, dynamic organization, latent organization, longitudinal viability, and internal predictive approximation. The framework is illustrated by three previously reported gait--occlusion studies, used here only as a methodological case sequence and not as new experimental evidence. The article formalizes how performance analysis led to latent organization, how static latent organization led to longitudinal viability, and how observed viability led to internal predictive approximation. The contribution is not a new learning algorithm, clinical protocol, or dataset, but a bootstrap framework for latent-space representation learning describing how increasingly informative representations can emerge from observational insufficiencies in adaptive biological data.

</details>


### [428] [Turning Back Without Forgetting: Selective Backward Refinement for Parameter-Efficient Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01379)
*Anushka Tiwari,Kaiyi Ji*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: SABER是一种无需重放的提示基参数高效持续学习方法，通过选择性后向精炼实现正向后向知识迁移，利用提示梯度几何和损失分布相似性判断何时精炼，并限制更新到非干扰方向以确保安全性，在多个基准和不同预训练骨干（T5-Large、LLaMA、Qwen）上一致取得正向后向迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有提示基参数高效持续学习虽能通过隔离任务特定提示来缓解灾难性遗忘，但这种隔离也阻止了后续任务对早期任务的改进，导致后向知识迁移未被充分探索。

Method: 提出SABER框架：1) 基于提示梯度几何和损失分布相似性的互补任务相关性准则，判断何时进行后向精炼有益；2) 通过将更新限制在提示参数空间中的非干扰方向，安全执行后向精炼。

Result: 在多个持续学习基准和不同预训练骨干（T5-Large、LLaMA、Qwen）上，SABER一致实现正向后向迁移，同时保持强整体平均性能。

Conclusion: SABER有效解决了提示基持续学习中后向知识迁移受限的问题，是一种无需重放且可控制后向迁移的框架。

Abstract: While prompt-based parameter-efficient continual learning mitigates catastrophic forgetting by isolating task-specific prompts, this isolation also limits later tasks from improving earlier ones, leaving backward knowledge transfer underexplored. We address this limitation by proposing Selective bAckward refinement for positive Backward knowledge transfER (SABER), a replay-free framework that enables controlled backward transfer in prompt-based continual learning. SABER determines when backward refinement is beneficial using complementary task-correlation criteria based on prompt-gradient geometry and loss-distribution similarity, and how to perform refinement safely by restricting updates to non-interfering directions in the prompt parameter space. Extensive experiments across multiple continual learning benchmarks and diverse pretrained backbones, including T5-Large, LLaMA, and Qwen, demonstrate that SABER consistently achieves positive backward transfer while maintaining strong overall average performance. Code is available at https://github.com/OptMN-Lab/SABER-ICML-2026/.

</details>


### [429] [Efficient Exploration for Iterative Nash Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01382)
*Tianlong Nan,Xiaopeng Li,Christian Kroer,Tianyi Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了在线迭代式纳什学习从人类反馈（NLHF）在通用偏好模型下的理论基础，发现标准迭代NLHF因缺乏显式探索会导致对KL正则化参数的指数依赖，并提出了一种结合SFT正则化与对抗性策略探索的显式探索迭代NLHF算法，实现了$O(\sqrt{T})$的遗憾界且无指数依赖，在Llama-3-8B-Instruct上验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准基于奖励的偏好对齐方法在人类偏好存在循环、非传递等不能被标量奖励表示的情况时具有局限性，而NLHF虽能通过偏好博弈和纳什均衡解决此问题，但其可扩展学习的理论基础仍然薄弱，现有方法存在遗憾保证缺失或依赖难以实现的基于oracle的方法等问题。

Method: 首先理论分析了标准迭代NLHF为何因隐式探索不足导致对KL正则化参数的指数依赖；然后提出显式探索的迭代NLHF算法，结合SFT正则化与对抗性策略探索，保留直接策略优化结构、避免显式偏好模型估计；理论上推导了$O(\sqrt{T})$遗憾界并在有minimax oracle时改进至$O(\log T)$；最后在Llama-3-8B-Instruct上对比现有NLHF基线进行实证评估。

Result: 标准迭代NLHF存在对KL正则化参数的指数依赖；所提显式探索算法达到$O(\sqrt{T})$遗憾界且无指数依赖；若有minimax oracle可提升至$O(\log T)$；在多个基准上显式探索持续优于现有NLHF基线。

Conclusion: 显式探索是实现在通用偏好模型下可扩展NLHF的关键，所提方法在保持迭代NLHF易实现性的同时提供了理论保证和实证性能提升，并揭示了学习通用偏好博弈中的计算-统计权衡。

Abstract: Preference alignment is central to improving large language models, but standard reward-based formulations can be restrictive when human preferences are cyclic, non-transitive, or otherwise not representable by a scalar reward. Nash Learning from Human Feedback (NLHF) addresses this limitation by modeling alignment as a preference game and targeting a Nash equilibrium rather than a reward maximizer. However, the learning-theoretic foundations of scalable NLHF remain limited. Existing regret guarantees rely on oracle-based methods that estimate a general preference model and solve KL-regularized minimax problems, while iterative NLHF methods directly optimize policy-level preference losses and are easier to implement but lack regret guarantees. We study online iterative NLHF under general preference models and identify exploration as the key obstacle. First, we show that standard iterative NLHF can suffer an exponential dependence on the KL-regularization parameter, revealing that implicit exploration through policy updates is insufficient for controlling regret. Second, we propose an explicitly exploratory iterative NLHF algorithm that combines SFT-based regularization with adversarial policy exploration. The resulting method retains the direct policy optimization structure of iterative NLHF, avoids explicit preference model estimation, and achieves an $O(\sqrt{T})$ regret bound without an exponential dependence on the KL-regularization parameter. We show that the regret can be improved to $O(\log(T))$ with access to a minimax oracle, clarifying the computational-statistical tradeoff in learning general preference games. Finally, we instantiate our method for LLM fine-tuning and evaluate it on \texttt{Llama-3-8B-Instruct} across multiple benchmarks, where explicit exploration yields consistent improvements over existing NLHF baselines.

</details>


### [430] [Neural Network Compression by Approximate Differential Equivalence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01402)
*Ravi Dhiman,Andrea Passarella,Mirco Tribastone,Lorenzo Valerio*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于神经元聚合的模型压缩方法，将训练好的网络编码为多项式ODE系统，利用近似前向微分等价性识别功能相似的神经元进行合并，通过单一参数ε控制压缩程度，在合成数据和回归基准上取得了优于剪枝方法的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的基于重要性分数的剪枝方法（如基于幅度的剪枝和Wanda）独立地移除权重，忽略了神经元之间的功能相似性。本文旨在提出一种互补的、基于神经元功能行为聚合的压缩方法，以更有效地减少模型参数。

Method: 将训练好的神经网络编码为多项式常微分方程（ODE）系统，应用近似前向微分等价性（Approximate Forward Differential Equivalence）方法，识别具有近似匹配诱导动力学的神经元，并将它们合并（聚合），通过单一容差参数ε控制压缩程度。

Result: 在非线性动力系统的合成数据集和公共回归基准上，该方法在保持精度的同时实现了显著的参数缩减，并且在相似压缩水平上一致优于基于幅度的剪枝和Wanda方法。

Conclusion: 基于微分等价性的神经元聚合是一种有原则且有效的替代传统以权重为中心的剪枝方法，能够在不牺牲预测性能的前提下实现模型压缩。

Abstract: Neural network compression is commonly achieved by pruning parameters based on local importance scores, e.g., magnitude-based pruning. We propose a complementary approach that compresses models by aggregating neurons with similar functional behavior rather than removing weights independently. Our method encodes a trained network as a polynomial ODE system and applies a lumping method called Approximate Forward Differential Equivalence to identify neurons with approximately matching induced dynamics. A single tolerance parameter, $\varepsilon$, controls the compression level and induces a smooth trade-off between model size and predictive accuracy. We evaluate the method on synthetic datasets derived from nonlinear dynamical systems with known ground-truth behavior and on public regression benchmarks. Across both settings, the proposed approach achieves substantial parameter reduction while preserving accuracy, and consistently compares favorably with magnitude-based pruning and Wanda at similar compression levels. These results suggest that differential equivalence-based aggregation is a principled and effective alternative to conventional weight-centric pruning.

</details>


### [431] [GPTQ-intrinsic LoRA: A Near-optimal Algorithm for Low-precision Quantization with Low-rank Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01412)
*Shihao Zhang,Rayan Saab*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究低精度加低秩（Low-Precision Plus Low-Rank, LPLR）表示的神经网络量化问题。首先给出了该问题在有限字母表和有限低秩补偿约束下的信息论下界。然后提出无训练算法GPTQ-intrinsic LoRA，将低秩校正直接融入GPTQ量化过程，并证明其层间重构误差界优于GPTQ。进一步提出Bid-Up固定网格量化细化步骤，保证非递增重构误差。实验在Qwen3语言模型和DeiT视觉模型上验证了方法的有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练量化（PTQ）广泛用于压缩大型神经网络，但激进的低位量化会显著降低模型质量。常用补救方法是对量化权重添加低秩校正，即$W\approx Q+LR$形式。本文旨在从理论上理解这种低精度加低秩表示，并设计更优的算法。

Method: 1) 建立信息论下界：在有限字母表和有限低秩补偿约束下，给出LPLR问题的首个体积意义上的下界。2) GPTQ-intrinsic LoRA：将低秩校正融入GPTQ量化过程，通过增广校准Hessian矩阵实现，且无需额外训练。特别地，当选择$L=V_r$（$V_r$包含$X$的顶部右奇异向量）时，推导出层间重构误差界，其中GPTQ对$\|X\|_F^2$的依赖被替换为秩$r$残差$\|X-X_r\|_F^2$。3) Bid-Up：一种固定网格量化细化步骤，可与最优低秩补偿交替进行，保证层间重构误差非递增。

Result: 1) 在理论方面，所提出的误差界在主导尺度上与信息论下界相匹配（至多常数和温和因子）。2) 在实验方面，GPTQ-intrinsic LoRA在Qwen3语言模型和DeiT视觉Transformer上显著优于GPTQ及GPTQ后接低秩补偿的方法，且细化循环可带来额外增益。

Conclusion: 本文为低精度加低秩表示提供了首个信息论下界，并提出了一种无训练的高效量化算法GPTQ-intrinsic LoRA及细化方案Bid-Up。理论与实验共同验证了该方法的有效性，有望推动大规模模型的高效部署。

Abstract: Post-training quantization is widely used for compressing large neural networks, but aggressive low-bit quantization can significantly degrade model quality. A common remedy is to augment the quantized weights with a low-rank correction, leading to approximations of the form $W\approx Q+LR$. In this paper, we study this low-precision plus low-rank representation through the layer-wise reconstruction objective $\|XW-X(Q+LR)\|_F^2$, where $X$ is a calibration matrix. We establish, to our knowledge, the first information-theoretic lower bounds for this problem under finite-alphabet and bounded low-rank compensation constraints. We then propose GPTQ-intrinsic LoRA, a training-free algorithm that incorporates the low-rank correction directly into a GPTQ-style quantization pass by appropriately augmenting the calibration Hessian. For the choice $L=V_r$, where $V_r$ contains the top right singular vectors of $X$, we prove layer-wise reconstruction error bounds in which the usual GPTQ dependence on $\|X\|_F^2$ is replaced by the rank-$r$ residual $\|X-X_r\|_F^2$, up to regularization terms. Under natural structural assumptions, these bounds match the information-theoretic lower bounds in their dominant scaling, up to constants and mild factors. We also introduce Bid-Up, a fixed-grid quantization refinement step that can be alternated with optimal low-rank compensation with guaranteed non-increasing layer-wise reconstruction error. Experiments on Qwen3 language models and DeiT vision transformers show that GPTQ-intrinsic LoRA improves over GPTQ and GPTQ followed by low-rank compensation, with additional gains from refinement loops.

</details>


### [432] [Target localization, identification and sensing using latent symmetries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01421)
*David Dukov,Malte Röntgen,Bryn Davies*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次利用潜伏对称性作为传感机制，通过分析散射体阵列中潜伏对称性被入侵者破坏的程度，实现入侵者半径识别和位置定位，并在三维开放系统中验证了该方法的有效性，采用贝叶斯推断或神经网络优于字典方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探索潜伏对称性在传感问题中的可行性，解决传统方法在三维开放系统中难以应用的局限。

Method: 以电容矩阵为三维杂化模型，设计具有潜伏对称性的散射体阵列；通过引入入侵者打破潜伏对称性，分析对称性破缺程度；采用字典方法、贝叶斯推断和人工神经网络（多层感知机）进行半径识别和位置定位。

Result: 潜伏对称性可成功用于传感；贝叶斯推断和神经网络在测量噪声存在时表现优于字典方法；首次在三维开放系统中观察到潜伏对称性。

Conclusion: 潜伏对称性可作为一种有效的传感机制，并在三维开放系统中得到验证，为传感技术提供新思路。

Abstract: We show that an array of scatterers which has been designed to have latent ("hidden") symmetries can be used as a sensor. We use the capacitance matrix as a canonical model for three-dimensional hybridisation and study how the introduction of an "intruder'' scatterer breaks the latent symmetries. By analysing the degree to which each symmetry is broken, we identify the radius of the intruder and localize its position. This can be achieved using a dictionary-based approach, however Bayesian inference or an artificial neural network (multi-layer perceptron) perform better in the presence of measurement noise. To our knowledge, this is the first time latent symmetries have been exploited successfully for sensing problems. It is also the first time latent symmetries have been observed in a three-dimensional open system that cannot be approximated by a sparse graph.

</details>


### [433] [Learning-based Directed Graph Abstraction of Combinatorial Spaces for Order-Preserving Search in Mixed-Combinatorial Nonlinear Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01425)
*Gishnu Madhu,Feng Liu,Souma Chowdhury*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于图神经网络（EFGN）的结构化抽象方法，将混合组合非线性规划（MCNLP）中的组合空间从无向完全图映射为有向图，以学习改进方向；将该抽象模型作为推荐系统嵌入仅搜索连续变量的优化框架中，在三个基准问题上相比传统索引化组合方法取得了更优的均值与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MCNLP问题广泛存在于工程设计、机器人规划等领域，传统组合空间表示（如整数/二进制编码）会引入虚假关系、增加维度并需要额外的兼容性约束，亟需一种更高效、可扩展且可解释的组合空间抽象方法。

Method: 提出Edge Field Graph Network (EFGN)模型，学习从无向完全组合图到指示改进方向的有向图的映射；将该抽象模型作为推荐系统嵌入仅优化连续变量的框架中，为每个候选连续设计检索最优组合。

Result: 在三个不同组合规模和变量数量的基准非线性问题上，将所提方法集成至粒子群优化和遗传算法中，相比于使用索引化组合的基线求解器，GNN-based推荐系统在多个运行中一致获得更优的均值最优值和更高的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该方向感知的抽象模型相比原始推荐系统在可扩展性和可解释性方面具有优势，为MCNLP问题的求解提供了一种新的有效范式。

Abstract: Mixed-combinatorial nonlinear programming (MCNLP) problems arise in many engineering design and planning applications, e.g., due to categorical, component, and geometric design choices, as well as joint task and motion planning. Traditional representations of combinatorial spaces, such as integer or binary encoding, often introduce spurious relations, increase dimensionality, and require additional compatibility constraints. Instead, this paper draws on recent developments in robot planning and vehicle/network routing domains that aim to learn search heuristics over combinatorial spaces using graph neural networks (GNNs). More specifically, this paper presents a first-of-its-kind structured abstraction of the combinatorial space by learning a mapping from an undirected fully connected graph of combinations to a directed graph indicating improvement directions using an Edge Field Graph Network (EFGN). To demonstrate the utility of this new way of abstracting the combinatorial space in solving MCNLPs, we adopt a recent optimization framework that purely searches over the non-combinatorial (e.g., continuous) variables and retrieves the best-suited combination for each candidate design by using the abstraction model, akin to a recommender system. The presented direction-aware abstraction model provides a potentially more scalable and interpretable retrieval of combinations compared to the original recommendation system in that framework. For evaluation, the proposed method is integrated with a well-known particle swarm optimization and genetic algorithm solvers on three benchmark nonlinear problems with varying numbers of combinations and variables. Compared to baseline solvers using indexified combinations, the GNN-based recommender consistently achieves better mean optimum values and robustness across multiple runs.

</details>


### [434] [CEAR: Certified Ensemble Adversarial Robustness in DNNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01437)
*Daniel Sadig,Mohammadreza Maleki,Hamed Karimi,Reza Samavi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CEAR是一种基于集成的混合鲁棒方法，结合经验性与认证性防御机制，通过添加高斯噪声、温度缩放、梯度混淆、噪声logits投票以及扩展随机平滑认证，在MNIST、CIFAR-10和TinyImageNet上实现了更高的认证精度、更大的鲁棒半径和更低的迁移性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络极易受到对抗性扰动的影响，现有经验性防御在面对自适应白盒攻击时仍显不足，而认证性防御能提供可证明的鲁棒性保证。本文旨在结合两者优势，提出一种兼具强鲁棒性与可认证性的混合防御方法。

Method: 提出CEAR框架：1）集成训练：每个网络使用不同的高斯噪声和温度参数进行训练，以混淆梯度和logits；2）基于噪声logits的两种投票机制进一步提升鲁棒性；3）扩展随机平滑方法，用于对集成分类器的鲁棒性进行认证。

Result: 在MNIST、CIFAR-10和TinyImageNet数据集上，CEAR相比基线方法在平均认证精度、鲁棒半径和对抗迁移性方面均取得更优结果。

Conclusion: 混合经验性与认证性防御的集成方法能有效提升深度神经网络对对抗攻击的鲁棒性，且具有可证明的认证保证。

Abstract: Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) are highly susceptible to adversarial perturbations, leading to extensive research on robustness for safety-critical applications. State-of-the-art empirical defense mechanisms improve the robustness of DNNs through the training phase, but still struggle against adaptive white-box attacks. On the other hand, certified defenses offer provable guarantees of robustness within a specified perturbation bound. These guarantees hold regardless of the level of perturbations, even if the attacker is given full knowledge of the model. In this paper, we propose CEAR, an ensemble-based robust method that utilizes a hybrid of empirical and certified defense mechanisms. CEAR trains each network within the ensemble using varying Gaussian noise and temperatures to obfuscate gradients and logits, making the model more resistant to stronger gradient-based attacks. We then use noisy logits and propose two different voting mechanisms to further improve robustness. Furthermore, we extend randomized smoothing to verify the robustness of ensemble-based classifiers. Our experimental evaluations on MNIST, CIFAR10, and TinyImageNet datasets demonstrate superior certified accuracy on average, increased robustness radius, and decreased transferability compared to baseline methods.

</details>


### [435] [UR-JEPA: Uniform Rectifiability as a Regularizer for Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01443)
*Triet M. Le*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UR-JEPA通过均匀可整流测度正则化（CGLT）替代LeJEPA的各向同性高斯正则化（SIGReg），在不牺牲精度的前提下（Inet10上+0.83pp，EuroSAT上96.0-96.1%）显著降低了种子方差（~30%），并产生了结构上不同的投影表示——PCA谱在20-25维处下降4-5个数量级（LeJEPA为近扁平谱），而边缘分布两者均近高斯。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 解决JEPA训练中的表示坍塌问题：LeJEPA采用各向同性高斯目标正则化，但与流形假设（嵌入应集中在低维子集上）存在张力，UR-JEPA旨在通过几何更自然的正则化目标克服这一矛盾。

Method: 提出UR-JEPA，以均匀n-可整流测度（局部切维数n）为目标，通过高斯核平滑的Carleson型平方函数L^{CGLT}实现，并辅以Jones β-数公式。与LeJEPA的SIGReg（各向同性高斯正则化）对比。

Result: Inet10上UR-JEPA达0.9141±0.0014，比LeJEPA高+0.83pp，种子标准差低~30%；Galaxy10 SDSS、ImageNet-100、EuroSAT上两者精度相当（EuroSAT 96.0-96.1%），但UR-JEPA保持更低种子方差。PCA谱：UR-JEPA在20-25/32维处下降4-5个量级，LeJEPA近扁平（比值≤3.6）；边缘分布均近高斯（Shapiro-Wilk W∈[0.992,0.996]）。

Conclusion: 两种正则化器在匹配精度下产生结构不同的投影表示：UR-JEPA的表示具有本质低维几何结构（符合流形假设），而LeJEPA的表示各向同性但缺乏这种低维集中性。UR-JEPA在保持竞争精度的同时，提供更低的种子方差和几何上更合理的表示空间。

Abstract: A central difficulty in training Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) is preventing representation collapse. LeJEPA addresses this by enforcing an isotropic Gaussian target on the embeddings via Sketched Isotropic Gaussian Regularization (SIGReg). This target is in tension with the manifold hypothesis, which expects embeddings to concentrate on a low-dimensional subset of the ambient space. We propose \emph{UR-JEPA}, which targets a uniformly $n$-rectifiable measure of local tangent dimension $n$ at small scales, realized through a Gaussian-kernel smoothed Carleson-type square function $\mathcal{L}^{\text{CGLT}}$, with a complementary Jones $β$-number formulation. On Inet10, UR-JEPA($\mathcal{L}^{\text{CGLT}}$) attains $0.9141 \pm 0.0014$ for a $+0.83$\,pp gain over LeJEPA($\mathcal{L}^{\text{SIGReg}}$) with $\sim 30\%$ lower seed standard deviation; on matched-recipe Galaxy10~SDSS, a single-seed ImageNet-$100$ run, and a $3$-seed EuroSAT remote-sensing run, the two methods lie in the same peak-accuracy band at convergence, with UR-JEPA retaining its lower-seed-variance signature. On EuroSAT the in-domain pair is competitive at $96.0$ to $96.1\%$ with large remote-sensing foundation-model transfer at a $25\times$ smaller backbone. The distinction is geometric: direct visualization of the projector output distribution shows that on all four datasets UR--JEPA($\mathcal{L}^{\text{CGLT}}$) produces a global PCA spectrum with a $4$ to $5$ order-of-magnitude drop at index $\sim 20$ to $25$ out of $D = 32$, while LeJEPA's spectrum is near-flat (top-to-bottom ratio at most $3.6$). Per-dimension marginals are simultaneously near-Gaussian for both methods (mean Shapiro-Wilk $W \in [0.992, 0.996]$) as a Diaconis-Freedman consequence. At matched accuracy the two regularizers therefore yield structurally distinct projected representations.

</details>


### [436] [Truthful AI Advisors: A Pre-Specified Benchmark for Large Language Model Honesty Under Preference Misalignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01456)
*Hamidreza Hasani Balyani,Seyed Pouyan Mousavi Davoudi,Alireza Amiri-Margavi,Amin Gholami Davodi,Arshia Gharagozlou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过Crawford-Sobel廉价谈话博弈的标准化基准，测试了四个指令微调大语言模型在偏好不一致情境下的诚实性。结果发现所有模型都过度透露信息（比最优均衡高出1.8-4.2倍），表现为近乎完全的揭示和线性夸张，而非理论预测的粗糙分区。收益最大化与诚实框架影响微乎其微，且该发现依赖于接收者对数字的准确解码。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型越来越多地被部署为与用户目标不一致的 advisors（如推荐系统优化参与度、销售助手优化购买量），核心问题是：当诚实与自身收益冲突时，模型是否保持诚实？现有工作缺乏一个理论驱动的、可量化的基准来评估LLM在这种偏好不一致下的诚实性。

Method: 将Crawford-Sobel廉价谈话博弈转化为LLM诚实性基准。发送者观察状态ω∈[0,1]，希望接收者行动接近ω+b，发送一条无成本消息给理想行动为ω的接收者。实验设计包含5个偏置水平、3种提示框架、固定低温设置、每单元200个状态，总计12,000次发送者调用。计算最优信息分区及其标准化互信息，对比四个指令微调模型（GPT-4o、Claude Sonnet 4.5、Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite、Llama-3.3-70B）的实际表现。

Result: 所有四个模型都过度透露信息：标准化互信息保持在0.78-0.94，而最优均衡预测值为0.18-0.53，过度揭示倍数为1.8-4.2倍。信息量随偏置增大而下降，但从未接近战略最优；呈现近乎完全的揭示加上线性夸张（constant upward offset tracking bias）。收益最大化与诚实框架影响可忽略。解码器消融实验表明，只有当接收者准确读取发送者陈述的数字时才能复现该发现，嵌入向量的解码器会将相同数据误读为近乎胡言乱语。

Conclusion: 当前指令微调LLM在偏好不一致情境下表现出系统性过度诚实（过度透露信息），而非理论预测的战略性模糊。这提示我们需要更好的对齐方法来处理激励冲突场景，且模型行为的评估依赖于下游解码方式。

Abstract: Large language models are increasingly deployed as advisors whose objective is not aligned with the user's: recommenders optimize for engagement, sales assistants for purchases, negotiation agents for concessions. Whether such advisors stay truthful when honesty conflicts with their own payoff is a core alignment-evaluation question. We turn the canonical Crawford-Sobel cheap-talk model into a pre-specified benchmark for LLM honesty under preference misalignment. Cheap-talk theory predicts neither full revelation nor silence but coarse monotone partitions, with fewer informative intervals as preference conflict grows. A sender observes a state omega in [0,1], wants the receiver's action near omega+b, and sends one costless message to a receiver whose ideal action is omega. The design uses 5 bias levels, 3 prompt frames, a fixed low-temperature setting, and 200 states per cell: 12,000 sender calls. For the positive-bias grid b in {0.01,0.04,0.08,0.12} the exact most-informative partition sizes are 7,4,3,2, with oracle normalized mutual information 0.5294, 0.3268, 0.2205, 0.1829. Running the full design on four instruction-tuned models (GPT-4o, Claude Sonnet 4.5, Gemini 2.5 Flash-Lite, Llama-3.3-70B), we find all four over-reveal relative to the most-informative equilibrium by 1.8 to 4.2x: normalized mutual information stays at 0.78-0.94 where the oracle prescribes 0.18-0.53. Informativeness declines with bias as predicted but never approaches the strategic optimum; rather than coarse partitions, models show near-full revelation with a constant upward offset tracking their bias (linear exaggeration). Payoff-maximizing versus honesty framing has negligible effect. A decoder ablation shows the finding is recoverable only when the receiver reads the sender's stated number: an embedding-only decoder mis-reads the same data as near-babbling.

</details>


### [437] [Genotype-Conditioned Molecular Generation via Evidence-Grounded Multi-Objective Latent Perturbation in Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01461)
*Brenda Nogueira,Gisela A. Gonzalez-Montiel,Nitesh V. Chawla,Nuno Moniz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于潜空间优化的基因型条件药物扩散模型，通过梯度上升优化复合奖励（药物敏感性、类药性、合成可及性），并在真实癌细胞数据上验证，实现了更优的抗癌药物生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 肿瘤异质性和缺乏明确分子靶点使抗癌药物开发困难，现有基因型条件生成模型未同时优化药物敏感性、可合成性和机制结合合理性。

Method: 在预训练的基因型到药物扩散模型上引入可学习的潜空间扰动，通过梯度上升最大化复合奖励（AUC+QED+SAS）；利用多智能体LLM流水线基于注意力机制评估机制一致性。

Result: 在15个癌细胞的三个留出评估集上，相比基线方法在敏感性、类药性、可合成性和化学有效性上均有显著提升。

Conclusion: 将潜空间优化与生物学 grounding 结合，能生成更具治疗潜力的候选药物分子。

Abstract: Developing effective anticancer therapeutics remains challenging due to tumor heterogeneity and the absence of well-defined molecular targets across cancer subtypes. Generative models conditioned on cancer genotypes offer a promising avenue for personalized drug discovery, yet existing approaches lack explicit optimization for simultaneous sensitivity, synthesizability, and mechanistic binding plausibility. We present a latent-space optimization approach for a pretrained genotype-to-drug diffusion model, introducing a learnable perturbation over the molecular latent space optimized via gradient ascent to maximize a composite reward combining predicted drug sensitivity (AUC), drug-likeness (QED), and synthetic accessibility (SAS). Critically, biological realism is enforced by grounding both reward design and evaluation in experimentally-derived cancer cell line data and validated pharmacologic signals, anchoring candidate generation in real-world clinical evidence. Mechanistic consistency plausibility is further assessed by a multi-agent LLM pipeline grounded in the diffusion model's attention mechanism. Experiments across 15 cancer cell lines from three held-out evaluation sets demonstrate consistent and noticeable improvements over competing baselines in sensitivity, drug-likeness, synthesizability, and chemical validity.

</details>


### [438] [OmniOPD: Logit-Free On-Policy Distillation via Speculative Verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01476)
*Yuhang Zhou,Lizhu Zhang,Yifan Wu,Mingyi Wang,Peng Bo,Jiayi Liu,Xiangjun Fan,Zhuokai Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: OmniOPD通过无logit的块级语义监督信号（蒙特卡洛rollout + 峰值熵调度 + 狄利克雷-多项先验）替代传统OPD的token级logits匹配，解决了对专有模型教师不可用及logits信号脆弱性问题，在数学基准上相比标准OPD提升高达+28.64%，结合黑盒教师（Claude-4.5-Haiku等）更取得额外+9.54%的相对增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 标准On-Policy Distillation (OPD)存在两个耦合局限：(1) 需要直接访问教师的token级logits，排除了大量优秀专有模型作为教师；(2) token级logits信号本身脆弱，依赖于师生间狭窄的重叠可预测token分布，且容易放大重复循环等退化模式。

Method: 提出OmniOPD框架：(1) 无logit的块级监督：用蒙特卡洛rollout近似教师对多token块的局部偏好，通过连续语义相似度指标评估；(2) 峰值熵调度器：仅在学生高不确定性的推理分叉点进行审计监督；(3) Dirichlet-Multinomial贝叶斯先验 + 基模型KL锚定，约束离散采样方差并防止策略崩溃。

Result: 在竞争性基准上，OmniOPD比标准OPD在数学任务上提升高达+28.64%；与Claude-4.5-Haiku和Gemini-2.5-Flash等黑盒教师配合时，相对其开源教师版本额外提升+9.54%，性能超越自探索RL。

Conclusion: 块级语义验证比token级logits匹配能提取更可靠的学习信号——后者高信息密度被显著噪声和脆弱性抵消；OmniOPD可有效利用黑盒强教师，突破OPD对开源模型的依赖限制。

Abstract: On-Policy Distillation (OPD) trains a student model on its own generative trajectories under dense token-level feedback from a stronger teacher, mitigating both the off-policy distribution shift of Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and the sparse credit assignment of Reinforcement Learning (RL). However, standard OPD faces two coupled limitations. First, it requires direct access to the teacher's token-level logits, excluding a broad class of capable proprietary models from serving as teachers. Second, the token-level logit signal itself is brittle, depending on a narrow overlap of plausible next tokens between teacher and student, and prone to amplifying degenerate patterns such as repetition loops. In this paper, we introduce OmniOPD, a novel framework that addresses both limitations through a logit-free, chunk-level supervision signal. OmniOPD replaces deterministic logit matching with Monte Carlo rollouts that approximate the teacher's local preferences through a continuous semantic similarity metric over multi-token chunks, and concentrates this supervision via a peak-entropy scheduler that audits the student only at its high-uncertainty reasoning forks. A Dirichlet-Multinomial Bayesian prior and a base-model KL anchor further bound the variance of discrete sampling and prevent policy collapse across unaudited tokens. Across competitive benchmarks, OmniOPD surpasses the standard OPD approach by up to +28.64% on math, confirming that chunk-level semantic verification extracts a more reliable learning signal than token-level logit matching, whose high information density is offset by significant noise and brittleness. Furthermore, when paired with stronger black-box teachers such as Claude-4.5-Haiku and Gemini-2.5-Flash, OmniOPD achieves an additional +9.54% relative on math over its open-weight teacher counterpart, advancing the student past the performance of self-exploratory RL.

</details>


### [439] [MURMUR: An Efficient Inference System for Long-Form ASR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01483)
*Wei-Tzu Lee,Keisuke Kamahori,Baris Kasikci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Murmur是一个两层级联推理系统，通过可调块大小和滑动窗口KV缓存驱逐策略，在长语音识别中实现了与单次模型相当的精度，同时延迟降低4.2倍。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的长语音识别系统在精度和延迟之间存在权衡：基于块的低延迟管道缺乏跨块上下文且依赖脆弱启发式对齐规则，而长上下文模型精度高但速度慢一个数量级。需要一种克服这种权衡的方案。

Method: Murmur在块间层级将块大小作为可调超参数，探索中等块大小以平衡精度与延迟；在块内层级采用基于滑动窗口的KV缓存驱逐策略，同时对输出token和语音token施加注意力稀疏性。

Result: 在AMI-IHM数据集上，Murmur匹配了单次模型的精度，同时将延迟降低4.2倍；结合token驱逐策略后，在tcpWER相对退化小于1%的情况下获得进一步性能提升。

Conclusion: 通过两层级联架构设计，Murmur成功打破了长语音识别中精度与延迟的固有折衷，为实际部署提供了一种高效解决方案。

Abstract: Long-form automatic speech recognition (ASR) requires both high accuracy and low latency, but existing systems force a trade-off between the two. Chunk-based pipelines process audio in parallel windows for low latency, but lose cross-chunk context and need brittle heuristics to align speakers and timestamps at boundaries. Long-context ASR models resolve everything in a single pass for better accuracy, but are an order of magnitude slower. We propose Murmur, an inference system that overcomes this trade-off by operating at two levels. At the inter-chunk level, we revisit the chunk-based pipeline for modern long-context ASR, treating chunk size as a tunable hyperparameter, and show that intermediate chunk sizes strike a good balance of accuracy and latency. At the intra-chunk level, we exploit attention sparsity through a sliding window KV cache eviction policy applied to both output and speech tokens. On AMI-IHM, Murmur matches single-pass accuracy while reducing latency by 4.2x, with further gains from token eviction at less than 1% relative tcpWER degradation. The code of Murmur is available at https://github.com/uw-syfi/Murmur.

</details>


### [440] [CART: Context-Anchored Recurrent Transformer -- A Parameter-Efficient Architecture with Learned Stability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01495)
*Chad A. Capps*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CART提出了一个参数高效的循环语言模型，通过重复使用单个共享核心块R次，并利用一次性计算的键值张量与多隐层注意力交叉关注。实验表明，前奏深度P主导循环次数R，全训练后R=6在d>=512时最优。在参数匹配测试中CART未超越密集基线，性能差距源于权重共享和异质框架，而循环核心机制本身影响微弱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有循环Transformer模型需要在每次迭代时重新计算键值张量，计算效率低下。本文旨在设计一种参数高效的循环语言模型，通过一次性计算键值张量并让循环核心交叉关注这些冻结张量，同时利用LTI门控保持循环稳定性，从而在单消费级GPU上实现高效训练。

Method: CART模型包含多层前奏（prelude）一次性计算K和V，然后共享核心块通过多隐层潜在注意力（multi-head latent attention）交叉关注这些冻结张量。使用学习得到的线性时不变（LTI）门控保持循环稳定性，其谱半径被约束在[0.79, 0.83]窄带内。模型采用两阶段训练：第一阶段64配置3,000步筛选，第二阶段36配置（P=6, R∈{6,8,10}, 三种随机种子）训练30,500步（约10亿token）。

Result: 两个模式在宽度d∈{256,512,768,1024}上一致：前奏深度P主导循环次数R；第一阶段R排序在全训练时反转（d>=512时R=6最优）。在d=1024参数匹配测试中，CART未超越参数匹配的密集基线：存储参数匹配下落后1-2%，有效参数匹配下落后约10%。消融实验将有效参数差距分解为约5%来自权重共享，约5%来自异质框架；循环核心机制（超连接、LTI门控、循环索引嵌入）各自影响甚微。变R推理在训练R两侧均出现退化。

Conclusion: CART模型在参数高效循环语言模型方面进行了系统探索，但未能超越传统的参数匹配密集基线。主要性能差距来源于权重共享和异质的prelude/anchor/core/coda框架，而非循环核心的具体机制。测试时深度缩放在该方案下呈现负面结果，变R推理会导致性能下降。这些发现对循环Transformer的设计空间提供了有价值的实证洞察。

Abstract: We present CART (Context-Anchored Recurrent Transformer), a parameter-efficient language model that reuses a single shared core block R times across depth. Unlike prior looped transformers that recompute key-value tensors at every iteration, CART computes K and V once from a multi-layer prelude and has the recurrent core cross-attend to those frozen tensors via multi-head latent attention. A learned Linear Time-Invariant (LTI) gate keeps the recurrence stable: its spectral radius settles in a narrow band (rho in [0.79, 0.83]) across all 36 fully-trained configurations.
  We evaluate CART on single consumer GPUs in two stages: a 64-configuration screen at 3,000 steps, then 36 configurations (P=6, R in {6,8,10}, three seeds) trained for 30,500 steps (~1B tokens). Two patterns hold across widths d in {256,512,768,1024}: prelude depth P dominates loop count R, and the Stage-1 ranking of R reverses at full training (R=6 becomes best at d>=512). At the binding d=1024 parameter-parity test, CART does not beat a parameter-matched dense baseline, losing by 1-2% at stored-parameter parity and by ~10% at effective-parameter parity. Diagnostic ablations split the effective-parameter gap into ~5% from weight sharing and a residual ~5% from the heterogeneous prelude/anchor/core/coda framing; the recurrent-core machinery (hyper-connections, LTI gate, loop-index embedding) is individually vestigial. Variable-R inference degrades on both sides of the trained R, a negative result for test-time depth scaling under this recipe.

</details>


### [441] [ProbMoE: Differentiable Probabilistic Routing for Mixture-of-Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01509)
*Heng Zhao,Zilei Shao,Guy Van den Broeck,Zhe Zeng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ProbMoE，一种概率路由框架，将MoE中的专家选择建模为带基数约束的子集分布，通过前向采样反向利用边际概率梯度进行训练，并支持动态k路由以自适应分配专家数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型中的top-k路由是离散且不可微的，需要设计梯度估计器来解决专家选择的优化问题，这仍是该领域的核心开放问题。

Method: ProbMoE Exact-k：前向采样k个专家子集，反向传播使用每个专家精确边际概率的梯度作为真实梯度的可计算替代。ProbMoE Dynamic-k：将训练和推理的路由基数约束在同一预定义范围内，实现自适应专家分配。

Result: Exact-k路由在多个基准和模型骨干上表现优于竞争基线，专家利用率和路由多样性得到提升；Dynamic-k路由在激活更少专家的情况下达到可比性能。

Conclusion: ProbMoE通过概率推断框架有效解决了MoE路由的离散优化问题，同时支持动态专家分配，实现了性能与效率的良好平衡。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models scale by activating only a small subset of experts per token. However, training such models remains challenging because top-$k$ routing is discrete and non-differentiable, requiring gradient estimators for expert selection whose design remains a central open problem. We introduce ProbMoE, a probabilistic routing framework that models expert selection as a distribution over cardinality-constrained expert subsets and formulates routing as probabilistic inference in this discrete subset space. We first propose ProbMoE Exact-$k$ routing, which samples $k$-expert subsets in the forward pass, and the backward pass uses gradients through each expert's exact marginal probability as a tractable surrogate for the true gradient. ProbMoE naturally generalizes to a dynamic-$k$ routing setting, where both training and inference constrain the routing cardinality to the same predefined range, allowing adaptive expert allocation per token. Across benchmarks and model backbones, ProbMoE Exact-$k$ achieves strong performance compared to competitive baselines, with improved expert utilization and routing diversity; ProbMoE Dynamic-$k$ achieves comparable performance with fewer activated experts.

</details>


### [442] [Near-Optimal Pure Machine Unlearning for Smooth Strongly Convex Losses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01527)
*Matthew Regehr,Gautam Kamath,Andrew Lowy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了机器遗忘（machine unlearning）在光滑强凸随机优化中的统计代价，通过建立近似ε-遗忘的超额风险上下界，证明了最优率等于标准统计误差加上一个遗忘惩罚项，该惩罚项在ε≫d时相比从头重训练有指数级的精度提升，在ε≤d时从头重训练为最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器遗忘受到法律（如被遗忘权）和用户需求驱动，但此前工作虽开发了遗忘算法和误差界，其基础统计代价仍不明确。

Method: 通过理论分析，证明了光滑强凸随机优化中近似ε-遗忘的超额总体风险的上界和下界，上下界在条件数因子内紧致；对单位球上的均值估计任务，上下界完全匹配。

Result: 最优率由标准统计误差加上遗忘惩罚项构成，该惩罚项在ε≫d时指数级小于从头重训练的误差；当ε≤d时，从头重训练为最优。与差分隐私基线相比，ε-遗忘算法在ε≫d时具有指数级精度优势。

Conclusion: 几乎完整解决了遗忘的统计代价问题，给出了紧致的理论界，揭示了遗忘误差与模型维度d和隐私参数ε之间的精确权衡关系。

Abstract: Machine unlearning is motivated by legal and user-facing requirements to remove the influence of individuals' data from trained models, such as the right to be forgotten. Prior work has developed algorithms and error bounds for unlearning in smooth strongly convex stochastic optimization, but the fundamental statistical cost of unlearning has remained unclear. We nearly resolve this problem by proving upper and lower bounds on the excess population risk of approximate $\varepsilon$-unlearning; our bounds are tight up to a condition-number factor. For mean estimation over the unit ball, our upper and lower bounds match. The optimal rate is the usual statistical error plus an unlearning penalty that interpolates between the retraining-from-scratch rate and an exponentially smaller term as $\varepsilon/d$ grows, where $d$ is the dimension of the model. In particular, when $\varepsilon \gg d$, our $\varepsilon$-unlearning algorithm offers an exponential accuracy improvement over retraining the model from scratch and differentially private baselines. On the other hand, when $\varepsilon \le d$, retraining from scratch is optimal.

</details>


### [443] [Rethinking the Role of Positional Encoding: Sliding-Window Transformers without PE Remain Turing Complete](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01532)
*Qian Li,Xinyu Mao,Shang-Hua Teng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明，在有限滑动上下文窗口的长序列推理场景中，无需位置编码的Transformer仍具有图灵完备性，因为窗口滑动机制本身已能打破排列对称性并提供足够的位置信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 挑战"位置编码是Transformer处理有序序列所必需"的传统认知，探究在滑动窗口场景下位置编码是否不可或缺。

Method: 引入抽象自回归模型HIST（基于常量内部状态和窗口内词元计数直方图），证明其图灵完备性；再构造一个无位置编码的滑动窗口Transformer，证明其能模拟HIST模型。

Result: 证明了HIST模型是图灵完备的；无位置编码的滑动窗口Transformer可模拟HIST模型，从而也具有通用计算能力。

Conclusion: 位置编码并非Transformer实现通用计算不可或缺的组件，滑动窗口机制本身已能打破排列对称性并提供足够的位置信息。

Abstract: Positional encoding (PE) is widely viewed as necessary for transformers to process ordered sequences: without them, the next-token map appears permutation-invariant in its context tokens. This intuition underlies all prior universality results, which rely on positional information to prove that transformers with chain-of-thought can perform arbitrary computation, i.e., they are Turing complete. We revisit this belief in the regime most relevant to long-form reasoning, where generation proceeds through a finite sliding context window. Our opening perception is that the window mechanism itself (mildly) breaks the permutation symmetry. To distill and precisely capture the degree of this added expressiveness, we introduce an abstract autoregressive model, the HIST model, in which each update depends only on constant-size internal state and the token-count histogram within the current window. We prove that this HIST model is Turing complete by showing that the evolution of the window can reveal the token that has just left the window, which suffices to simulate Turing-complete Post machines. We then construct a sliding-window transformer over a constant-size token alphabet, without PE, and show that it can simulate the HIST model. Our result demonstrates that positional encodings are not indispensable for transformers to perform universal computation: The window sliding itself already breaks permutation symmetry and captures sufficient positional information.

</details>


### [444] [TN-SHAP-G: Graph-Structured Tensor Network Surrogates for Shapley Values and Interactions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01540)
*Farzaneh Heidari,Guillaume Rabusseau*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TN-SHAP-G框架，利用图结构输入中的拓扑信息，通过张量网络代理模型高效计算Shapley值及高阶交互指标，无需蒙特卡洛采样即可精确恢复一阶和高阶Shapley指数。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Shapley值计算涉及指数级子集空间，传统方法在输入具有图结构时效率低下，现有采样方法存在方差且难以扩展到大图。

Method: 构建与输入图拓扑对齐的多线性代理模型（张量网络），从少量查询中学习后，通过多线性扩展直接解析恢复Shapley值和高阶交互指数。

Result: 在小分子图上与精确Shapley值高度吻合，在大图上比采样方法更高效且可行。

Conclusion: TN-SHAP-G为图结构输入提供了一种可扩展、无采样方差的Shapley值计算范式，适用于分子等图数据的模型解释。

Abstract: Shapley values are a widely used tool for attributing importance and interactions among input variables in black-box models, but their computation involves a function defined over an exponentially large space of subsets. We propose TN-SHAP-G, a framework that exploits structure in graph-structured inputs to compute Shapley values and higher-order interaction indices efficiently. Given a predictor and a fixed masking scheme, TN-SHAP-G learns a compact, graph-aligned multilinear surrogate that approximates the masked-input behavior, represented as a tensor network whose topology mirrors the input graph. Once trained from a small number of oracle queries, the surrogate enables deterministic recovery of first- and higher-order Shapley indices via the multilinear extension, without additional model queries or Monte Carlo variance. Experiments on molecular benchmarks show that the learned factorization closely matches exact Shapley values on small graphs and scales efficiently to larger graphs where sampling-based methods become infeasible.

</details>


### [445] [CRePE: Convolution-aware Relative Importance in Post-training Pruning with Efficient Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01544)
*Cheonjun Park*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CRePE方法，通过引入2D局部邻域上下文和自适应系数改进相对重要性剪枝评分，并进一步提出PHO代理超参数优化方法将搜索时间从11小时降至20分钟，在多种模型和稀疏度设置下取得最优性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有后训练剪枝方法RIA仅考虑1D十字形（行/列）方向信息且对行列贡献赋予相等权重，忽略了权重矩阵中2D局部邻域上下文的重要性，导致剪枝精度受限。

Method: 提出CRePE方法，在相对重要性评分中融入2D局部邻域上下文和自适应系数；同时提出PHO代理超参数优化方法，通过代理指标替代PPL评估，将搜索时间从11小时降至20分钟。

Result: CRePE在多种模型和稀疏度设置下一致优于现有PTP方法；PHO将超参数搜索时间从约11小时降至约20分钟，且最优配置可跨模型迁移。

Conclusion: CRePE是一种有效的后训练剪枝方法，PHO解决了其超参数搜索效率问题，且CRePE可与通道重排、非均匀稀疏分配、重剪枝等技术正交结合。

Abstract: Deploying Large Language Models (LLMs) in practice incurs substantial memory and computational costs. Post-training pruning (PTP) is an effective approach to reducing these costs by removing weights without additional training. Among existing methods, RIA introduces relative importance scores normalized by row and column sums, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy. However, RIA considers only 1D cross-shaped (row/column) directional information and assigns equal weight to row and column contributions. In this paper, we propose \textbf{CRePE}, which incorporates 2D local neighborhood context and adaptive coefficients into Relative Importance scoring. CRePE consistently outperforms existing PTP methods across diverse models and sparsity settings. However, identifying optimal adaptive coefficients via perplexity (PPL)-based hill climbing requires numerous PPL evaluations and approximately 11 hours of search time. To address this, we propose \textbf{PHO} (Proxy-based Hyperparameter Optimization), which eliminates the need for repeated PPL measurements and reduces the search time to approximately 20 minutes. Furthermore, the optimal hyperparameter configuration found by PHO on one model transfers well to other models, demonstrating strong generalization. Finally, we verify that CRePE can be orthogonally combined with existing techniques including Channel Permutation, non-uniform sparsity allocation, and re-pruning methods.

</details>


### [446] [Flexible Online Representation Learning Based on Similarity Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01546)
*Shagesh Sridharan,Yanis Bahroun,Anirvan M. Sengupta*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种在线生物可塑性学习算法，能够学习稀疏且具有平移不变性的高维表示，适用于聚类、流形平铺和稀疏编码等无监督探索任务，解决了传统方法在计算复杂度和可扩展性上的局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏高维表示有助于发现无监督数据探索中的非平凡结构（如社区检测中的密集连接、流形平铺和特征学习），但现有方法受限于完全正矩阵的计算不可行性或双非负矩阵的规模扩展性问题，且行和约束（如双随机性）虽具有平移不变性优势却缺乏高效的在线学习规则。

Method: 提出一种在线且符合生物可塑性原则的学习算法，该算法能够学习稀疏且具有平移不变性的表示，在输出相似性矩阵上施加行和约束，并通过在线学习规则实现可扩展性。

Result: 该算法能够根据数据结构灵活适用于聚类、流形平铺或稀疏编码任务，具有生物可塑性、在线学习能力和大规模数据可扩展性。

Conclusion: 该在线生物可塑性学习算法为稀疏平移不变表示学习提供了一种实用且可扩展的解决方案，弥合了计算复杂度与实际应用之间的差距。

Abstract: Sparse high-dimensional representations are conducive to uncovering nontrivial structures in unsupervised exploration of data. Such a representation can deal with the dense connectivity in graphs relevant to community detection problems. However, sparse high-dimensional representations are capable of doing more, including manifold tiling and feature learning. Conventional algorithms optimize in the space of computationally intractable completely positive matrices or relax the problem to the space of doubly nonnegative matrices that scale with sample size in a way rendering them impractical for large data sets. Some of these methods also impose a row sum constraint, such as double stochasticity. Row sum constraints have the added advantage of being shift-invariant, in the context of manifold tiling. Constraints on the row sum of output similarity matrices require nontrivial online learning rules. Addressing these needs, we propose a versatile online biologically plausible learning algorithm capable of learning sparse shift-invariant representations, useful for clustering, manifold tiling, or sparse coding, depending on the data structure.

</details>


### [447] [Everywhere Learning: Artificial Intelligence with Pointwise Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01557)
*Ignacio Boero,Ignacio Hounie,Luiz Chamon,Alejandro Ribeiro*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"无处不在学习"的新范式，与传统最小化平均损失不同，它要求AI系统以概率1满足损失约束。通过近似对偶理论建立了经验解与统计解之间的泛化分析，发现对偶变量会重加权数据分布，而泛化能力由数据分布质量集中与困难约束点集中之间的不匹配程度控制。L1稀疏惩罚可控制泛化，并在语言模型代理分类任务中验证了有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统AI训练范式优化平均损失，但在安全关键场景中，即使平均表现良好，罕见但高风险的失败案例仍不可接受，因此需要一种确保约束几乎处处满足的新范式。

Method: 开发了近似对偶理论进行泛化分析，证明经验解与统计解之间的接近性；引入L1稀疏惩罚控制泛化；在语言模型代理分类任务上进行实验验证。

Result: 对偶变量将数据分布重加权到约束更难以满足的点；泛化受数据分布质量集中与困难约束点集中之间的不匹配程度控制；L1稀疏惩罚可有效控制泛化。

Conclusion: 无处不在学习为高可靠性AI系统提供了新的训练范式，通过重加权机制和稀疏惩罚实现了对约束违反风险的有效控制，在语言模型代理分类中展现了优势。

Abstract: Everywhere learning is a new paradigm whereby Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems are trained to satisfy loss constraints with probability one over the data distribution. This is in contrast to the standard paradigm of training AI systems to minimize average losses. We develop an approximate duality theory to substantiate a generalization analysis that establishes the proximity between solutions of empirical and statistical everywhere learning problems. Our results show that dual variables reweigh the data distribution towards points in which loss constraints are more difficult to satisfy and that generalization is controlled by the mismatch between the concentration of mass of the data distribution and the concentration of mass on points where constraints are more difficult to satisfy. We further show that we can control generalization with a sparse L1 penalty on constraint relaxations. We illustrate the merits of everywhere learning with an experiment in agentic classification for language model tasks.

</details>


### [448] [GJDNet: Robust Graph Neural Networks via Joint Disentangled Learning Against Adversarial Attacks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01560)
*Canyixing Cui,Tao Wu,Xingping Xian,Xiao-Ke Xu,Mao Wang,Weina Niu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出GJDNet，通过解耦节点表示和决策空间来增强GNN对对抗攻击的鲁棒性，在表示层面使用特征驱动的软结构解耦和偏态感知邻居过滤，在决策层面引入球形决策边界，实验证明该方法在不同图类型上均表现出强鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有GNN防御方法存在局限性：要么将邻域视为整体且基于固定的同配性假设，要么依赖无法应对扰动导致的表示偏移的标准softmax分类器。作者希望从鲁棒性视角出发，同时解耦节点表示和决策空间来应对对抗攻击。

Method: 提出GJDNet框架，包含两个核心机制：(1) 表示层面：特征驱动的软结构解耦与偏态感知邻居过滤，抑制扰动引起的结构-特征不匹配；(2) 决策层面：球形决策边界（SDB），促进嵌入空间中类内紧凑性和类间分离性。

Result: 理论分析证明了解耦表示和决策机制的有效性，大量实验表明GJDNet在不同连接模式的图上均一致地实现了强鲁棒性。

Conclusion: GJDNet通过联合解耦节点表示和决策空间，有效应对了不同同配性图上的对抗攻击，是一个统一的鲁棒节点分类框架。

Abstract: Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) are vulnerable to adversarial attacks, which inherently invert connectivity patterns by introducing disassortative edges in assortative graphs and assortative edges in disassortative graphs. This structural inversion creates structure-feature mismatches that disrupt neighborhood aggregation across different graph types. However, we find that existing defenses are limited, as they either treat neighborhoods as monolithic under fixed assortativity assumptions or rely on standard softmax classifiers that fail to account for perturbation-induced representation shifts. To further exploit this observation, we adopt a robustness perspective that jointly disentangles node representations and decision spaces, isolating perturbation effects while enforcing well-separated decision regions. Based on this principle, we propose Graph Joint Disentanglement Network (GJDNet), a unified framework for robust node classification across diverse graph assortativity regimes. GJDNet enhances robustness at both representation and decision levels: it employs feature-driven soft structural disentanglement with skewness-aware neighbor filtering to suppress perturbation-induced structure-feature mismatches, and introduces a Spherical Decision Boundary (SDB) to promote intra-class compactness and inter-class separation in the embedding space, thereby stabilizing decision boundaries under perturbations. Theoretical analysis provides insights into the effectiveness of the proposed disentangled representation and decision mechanisms, while extensive experiments demonstrate that GJDNet consistently achieves strong robustness across graphs with different connectivity regimes.

</details>


### [449] [MomentKV: Closing the Directional Gap in KV Cache Eviction for Long-Context Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01563)
*Yu Li,Binxu Li,Tian Lan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MomentKV提出了一种新的KV缓存淘汰策略，通过维护被淘汰token集的矩统计量（计数、键均值、值均值、值-键协方差）来近似被淘汰注意力的输出，解决了现有方法中保留集与淘汰集方向不匹配导致的输出退化问题，在长上下文基准测试中表现优于所有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有KV缓存淘汰方法虽然最小化了被淘汰token上的残余注意力质量，但忽视了保留集与淘汰集之间的方向不匹配问题——被淘汰token在方向上与保留token近乎正交，即使残余注意力质量很小也会放大为显著的输出误差，暴露出当前策略的根本局限。

Method: 维护被淘汰token集的紧凑矩统计量（计数、键均值、值均值、值-键协方差）；利用这些统计量在淘汰时识别已与累积摘要良好对齐的token；在推理时通过封闭形式的一阶近似来校正被淘汰注意力的输出，形成选择性淘汰与精确校正的互促循环。

Result: 在LongBench和RULER上使用LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct和Qwen3-4B-Instruct评估，MomentKV在所有缓存预算下均优于所有基线方法，在激进压缩条件下增益最为显著。

Conclusion: MomentKV通过矩统计量近似被淘汰注意力输出，有效解决了方向不匹配问题，为长上下文推理中的KV缓存管理提供了更优方案。

Abstract: Autoregressive decoding in Transformer-based language models relies on the KV cache, whose memory footprint grows linearly with sequence length and becomes the primary bottleneck for long-context inference. KV cache eviction addresses this by retaining a fixed-size subset of key-value pairs and discarding the rest. We identify that a primary source of output degradation is not the residual attention mass on evicted tokens, which existing methods already minimize, but a directional mismatch between the retained and evicted token sets. Specifically, the evicted tokens in practice are often near-orthogonal to the retained ones. Thus, even a small evicted mass could have an oversized impact on the resulting direction distribution and amplify into substantial output error. This reveals a fundamental limit in existing strategies. To address this, we propose MomentKV, which maintains compact, small-size moment statistics over the evicted token set, including a count, key mean, value mean, and value-key covariance. During eviction, the moment statistics is leveraged to identify tokens already well aligned with and captured by the accumulated summary, keeping the evicted set geometrically regular. During inference, they yield a closed-form first-order approximation of the evicted attention output, forming a mutually reinforcing loop between selective eviction and accurate correction. On LongBench and RULER with LLaMA-3.1-8B-Instruct and Qwen3-4B-Instruct, MomentKV outperforms all baselines at every cache budget, with the largest gains under aggressive compression.

</details>


### [450] [RobustModelMaker: Coupling Bootstrap Stability Selection with Leakage-Safe Nested Cross-Validation for Scientific Machine Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01566)
*Amanda S Barnard*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出RobustModelMaker框架，通过结合Bootstrap稳定性选择与严格嵌套交叉验证，解决了小到中等规模科学数据集中特征选择不稳定和性能评估乐观偏倚的双重问题，并在多个数据集上验证了其在预测性能与选择稳定性联合前沿上的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 小到中等规模科学数据集使机器学习流程面临两个相互叠加的压力：单次特征选择产生的特征集在训练数据小幅扰动下变化显著，且任何使用相同数据进行选择、调优和评估的过程都会产生乐观偏倚的性能估计。这两种失效模式通常被视为可分离的，但在科学数据的场景中它们相互交互：不稳定的选择加剧了本就乐观的评分方差，而针对一种问题的标准补救措施很少能解决另一种。

Method: RobustModelMaker是一个Python框架，将Bootstrap稳定性选择与严格嵌套交叉验证相结合，所有预处理和特征选择均在每一折内部完成，输出经过稳定性测试的特征子集以及无泄漏风险的性能估计。框架支持二分类、多分类和回归任务共九种算法，并通过包含单元测试、性能测试和可重复性检验的确定性测试套件进行验证。

Result: 在三个真实科学数据集上，与ANOVA F检验、递归特征消除交叉验证和Boruta三种备选选择器相比，RobustModelMaker在预测分数上与每个数据集上最佳备选选择器竞争力相当，并在联合分数-稳定性前沿上占据一个所有备选方法在三种任务类型上均无法匹配的位置。

Conclusion: 通过卵巢癌生物标志物发现和超导临界温度回归两个实例，展示了该框架的实际应用以及当稳定性被视作一等交付物而非涌现属性时所能观察到的权衡关系。

Abstract: Small-to-medium scientific datasets place machine learning pipelines under two compounding pressures. Single-run feature selection produces feature sets that change substantially under small perturbations of the training data, and any procedure that uses the same data for selection, tuning, and evaluation produces optimistically biased performance estimates. The two failure modes are routinely treated as separable, but in the regimes where scientific data live, they interact: an unstable selection inflates the variance of an already-optimistic score, and standard remedies for one rarely address the other. RobustModelMaker is a Python framework that couples bootstrap stability selection with strict nested cross-validation, performs all preprocessing and selection inside each fold, and produces a stability-tested feature subset together with a leakage-safe performance estimate. The framework supports nine algorithms across binary classification, multiclass classification, and regression. Behaviour is verified by a deterministic test suite spanning unit, performance, and reproducibility checks on three real scientific datasets comparing to three alternative selectors (ANOVA F-test, recursive feature elimination with cross-validation, and Boruta) on both predictive score and a Jaccard measure of selection stability. RobustModelMaker is competitive in score with the best alternative selector on each dataset, and occupies a position on the joint score-stability frontier that none of the alternatives match across all three task types. Two example applications, ovarian cancer biomarker discovery from the PLCO Trial and critical-temperature regression on the UCI Superconductivity Data, illustrate how the framework is used in practice and what trade-offs become visible when stability is treated as a first-class deliverable rather than an emergent property.

</details>


### [451] [Uncertainty-Calibrated Diffusion for Reliable 3D Molecular Graph Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01595)
*Fang Wan,Jingxiang Qu,Yi Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出UCD方法，通过校准反向扩散过程中的认知不确定性，解决了扩散模型在3D分子生成中因认知不确定性与偶然不确定性相互作用导致方差膨胀和分布不匹配的问题，在多个基准上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型在3D分子图生成中，认知不确定性（来自学习去噪器）与偶然不确定性（反向扩散中有意注入）相互作用导致系统性方差膨胀，使真实分布与模拟分布不匹配，影响高精度分子生成的化学有效性。

Method: UCD (Uncertainty-Calibrated Diffusion)：一种校准反向扩散过程以考虑认知不确定性的方法。

Result: 在标准3D分子基准测试上，UCD持续提升多种基线方法的采样质量，达到新的SOTA性能。

Conclusion: 理论分析和实验证明，校准认知不确定性能够有效改善扩散模型的分子生成质量。

Abstract: Bayesian inference provides a principled framework for modeling epistemic uncertainty in neural networks by treating predictions as distributions rather than deterministic values. Meanwhile, diffusion-based models for 3D molecular graph generation operate on fragile geometric structures governed by strict chemical constraints, making inference highly sensitive to uncertainty miscalibration. A largely overlooked issue is that epistemic uncertainty arising from the learned denoiser interacts with the aleatoric uncertainty intentionally injected during reverse diffusion, leading to systematic variance inflation and a mismatch between the true distribution and the simulated distribution. This effect is particularly detrimental for high-precision molecular generation, where even small deviations can violate chemical validity. In this work, we provide a theoretical and empirical analysis of how epistemic uncertainty propagates through diffusion inference and degrades sampling quality. Building on this investigation, we propose UCD (Uncertainty-Calibrated Diffusion), a simple yet effective method that calibrates the reverse diffusion process to account for epistemic uncertainty. Extensive experiments on standard 3D molecular benchmarks demonstrate that UCD consistently improves sampling quality across diverse baseline methods, establishing new state-of-the-art performance for 3D molecular diffusion. The code is available at https://github.com/jiuguaiwf/UCD.

</details>


### [452] [Estimating Mutual Information between Time Series and Temporal Event Sequences Across Diverse Analysis Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01602)
*Haoji Hu,Huaqing Mao,Yijun Lin,Xiaowei Jia,Jinwei Zhou,Minoh Jeong,Yao-Yi Chiang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种非参数互信息估计器，无需数据变换或离散化，直接量化连续时间序列与离散事件序列之间的依赖关系，通过处理量化伪影和事件冗余，在多个任务上显著优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法在处理异质时间数据（连续时间序列与离散事件序列）间的依赖关系时，依赖临时数据变换或互信息估计器，对量化、重复值和事件冗余高度敏感，导致结果有偏且不稳定，缺乏一个稳健且原则性的量化框架。

Method: 提出非参数互信息估计器，核心包括：(1) 建模连续-离散二元性以处理量化与重复值伪影；(2) 引入潜在事件聚类策略以减轻事件共现和冗余导致的偏差，从而构建一个统一的离散-连续互信息框架。

Result: 在四个代表性任务（时滞互信息因果分析、全局/局部时间重复发现、离散协变量选择用于时间序列预测、连续特征选择用于分类）上，合成数据与真实数据实验均表明，该方法在准确性、鲁棒性和可解释性上持续优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 该方法可作为异质时间数据的通用依赖算子，类似于Pearson相关系数在同质时间序列中的地位，且代码已开源。

Abstract: Pairwise dependence measures such as correlation and causality are fundamental to temporal data mining, yet there is still no principled and robust way to quantify dependence between heterogeneous data types, especially between continuous time series and discrete temporal event sequences. Existing approaches rely on ad hoc transformations or mutual-information estimators that are highly sensitive to quantization, repeated values, and event redundancy, leading to biased or unstable results in practice. We propose a nonparametric mutual information estimator that directly measures the dependence between time series and event sequences without data transformation, learning, or ad hoc discretization. Our method models the continuous-discrete duality of real-world time series to handle quantization and repeated-value artifacts and introduces a latent event clustering strategy to mitigate bias from event co-occurrence and redundancy. Together, these yield a robust and unified framework that bridges discrete and continuous mutual information. We evaluate the proposed estimator on four representative tasks: discrete-continuous time-delayed mutual information for causality analysis, global and local temporal repetition discovery, discrete covariate selection for time series forecasting, and continuous feature selection for classification. Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets show consistent improvements over existing methods in accuracy, robustness, and interpretability, positioning our approach as a general-purpose dependence operator for heterogeneous temporal data, similar to Pearson correlation for homogeneous time series. Code available at: https://github.com/HaojiHu/Multimodal-Temporal-Data-Quantification

</details>


### [453] [FedMTFI: Feature Importance Based Optimized Multi Teacher Knowledge Distillation in Heterogeneous Federated Learning Environment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01607)
*Nazmus Shakib Shadin,Aaron Cummings,Xinyue Zhang,Bobin Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FedMTFI架构，通过多教师知识蒸馏结合SHAP特征重要性，解决非IID数据和设备异构性下的联邦学习性能问题，实验证明精度优于传统FL方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中设备数据非独立同分布（non-IID）且算力/内存异构，导致系统难以维持一致的性能表现。

Method: 1) 按硬件和模型类型对客户端聚类；2) 每个聚类在non-IID数据上训练特定模型；3) 服务器用FedAvg聚合各聚类内的本地模型形成多个原型模型（教师）；4) 利用多教师知识蒸馏（MTKD）训练全局学生模型；5) 引入SHAP值强调蒸馏过程中的重要特征。

Result: 在non-IID数据条件下，FedMTFI相比传统FL算法获得更高精度，且表现更有效。

Conclusion: 结合多教师知识蒸馏与SHAP特征重要性可有效提升异构联邦学习的准确率和可解释性。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a decentralized approach that enables collaborative model training without exposing raw data. Instead of transferring sensitive data, it allows devices to share only model weights, keeping personal data locally and secure. However, in real world settings, the data held by devices is often not evenly distributed and devices mostly differ in computing power and memory capacity. These differences make FL harder to maintain consistent performance across the system. To address these issues, we propose FedMTFI, a novel architecture that combines multi-teacher knowledge distillation (MTKD) with feature importance to improve the FL process in heterogeneous environments. In FedMTFI, clients are clustered based on similar hardware and model types. Each cluster trains a specific model on not independently and identically distributed (non-IID) data. Within a cluster, every client updates that model using only its own local private data. The server then aggregates the locally trained models in each cluster using FedAvg to form multiple prototype models. Then these prototypes serve as teacher models to train a global generalized student model using MTKD. What makes FedMTFI more unique is the integration of Shapley values (SHAP) to emphasize important features during distillation, which enhances both accuracy and interpretability. Experimental results show that FedMTFI achieves higher accuracy than traditional FL algorithms and performs more effectively under non-IID data conditions.

</details>


### [454] [IMWM: Intuition Models Complement World Models for Latent Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01626)
*Baoqi Gao,Ruize Han,Miao Wang,Song Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出IMWM框架，将直觉模型（从演示中学习）与潜在世界模型结合，通过检索初始化、混合成本和可靠性门控三个轻量组件提升基于采样的规划器在像素级目标到达任务中的成功率，实验表明即使完美世界模型也会因搜索瓶颈而失败，而IMWM在四个任务上均优于纯世界模型方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于潜在世界模型的规划方法中，即使世界模型本身是完美的（即用真实环境动力学替代学习的前向预测器），有限预算下的基于采样的规划器仍会在某些任务上失败，说明瓶颈在于搜索而非世界模型精度。现有方法忽视了这一搜索瓶颈问题。

Method: 提出IMWM框架，包含三个轻量组件：(i) 检索初始化——从演示中检索轨迹来初始化规划器的动作提议；(ii) 混合成本——将直觉模型评分与世界模型 rollout 成本结合；(iii) 可靠性门控——根据场景动态调整规划器对直觉模型的信任程度。

Result: 在Two-Room、Reacher、Push-T和OGBench-Cube四个基于像素的目标到达任务上，IMWM的平均成功率均高于纯世界模型规划器，其中Two-Room达到99.2%（提升+11.5个百分点），OGBench-Cube达到94.7%（提升+28.5个百分点）。

Conclusion: 有限预算下的搜索瓶颈是规划失败的关键因素之一，而将直觉模型（从演示中学习）与世界模型结合能有效缓解这一问题，提升规划器在复杂视觉控制任务中的性能。

Abstract: Planning with a learned latent world model is a promising route to control from raw pixels, but a strong world model alone is not enough. We show this experimentally: even with a perfect world model (operationalized by replacing the learned forward predictor with an idealized rollout of the true environment dynamics), a finite-budget sample-based planner still fails on some tasks, indicating that the bottleneck can lie in search rather than in world-model accuracy. Motivated by this gap, we propose IMWM (Intuition Model + World Model), which pairs the world model with an intuition model trained from demonstrations to recognize promising actions. The two models collaborate through three lightweight components: (i) Retrieval Initialization, which initializes the planner's action proposal from a retrieved demonstration; (ii) Hybrid Cost, which combines the intuition score with the world-model rollout cost; and (iii) a Reliability Gate, which adjusts how much the planner trusts intuition in each setting. Across four pixel-based goal-reaching tasks (Two-Room, Reacher, Push-T, and OGBench-Cube), IMWM has higher mean success than the world-model-only planner on all four, with the largest gains on Two-Room (99.2%, +11.5 percentage points) and OGBench-Cube (94.7%, +28.5 percentage points).

</details>


### [455] [E4GEN: Event-level Explainable Extreme-Enhanced Time-series Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01634)
*Lin Jiang,Dahai Yu,Ximiao Li,Guang Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出E4GEN，一个可解释的扩散框架，用于生成包含极端事件的时间序列，通过三个组件（E-Activator、E-Predictor、E-Control）系统控制极端事件的生成时机、信号内容和注入方式，在6个数据集上超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有时间序列生成方法注重整体分布保真度，但未能准确捕捉极端事件。需要一种能够系统性地控制极端事件生成的方法。

Method: E4GEN包含三个组件：1) E-Activator：自适应学习极端控制信号激活步长，不干扰趋势和季节性等常规成分；2) E-Predictor：通过自驱动语义预测（Self-Driven Semantic Prediction）确定控制信号，并采用数据条件训练与噪声初始采样（Data-Conditioned Training, Noise-Initiated Sampling）解决训练标签缺失问题；3) E-Control：通过可训练的极端控制网络（Extreme Control Network）将语义信号转换为逐层信号注入去噪过程。

Result: 在6个数据集上使用17个指标进行评估，E4GEN在整体保真度、极端事件保真度和下游任务实用性上均优于现有最先进模型。

Conclusion: E4GEN通过可解释的扩散框架有效实现了极端事件感知的时间序列生成，系统性解决了何时、何种信号以及如何控制极端事件生成三个关键问题。

Abstract: Generating realistic time series is essential for scientific research and real-world applications. However, existing methods often emphasize overall distributional fidelity while failing to faithfully capture extreme events. To advance existing research, we propose E4GEN, an explainable diffusion framework for extreme event-aware time-series generation. E4GEN provides systematic insights into when, what, and how to control extreme-event generation through three key components. First, E-Activator learns the dataset-adaptive extreme-control signal activation step during the denoising process without interfering with regular temporal components, including trend and seasonality. Second, E-Predictor determines what control signal to enforce through Self-Driven Semantic Prediction, where each sample derives its own control signal by inferring latent extreme-event information during generation. It also includes a novel Data-Conditioned Training, Noise-Initiated Sampling mechanism to address the issue of unavailable training labels. Third, E-Control specifies how to control extreme-event generation through a trainable Extreme Control Network, which transforms the semantic control signal into layer-wise signals and injects it into the denoising process. We evaluate E4GEN on six datasets with 17 metrics, and extensive experiments show that E4GEN outperforms state-of-the-art models across multiple dimensions, including overall fidelity, extreme-event fidelity, and downstream utility.

</details>


### [456] [Gate the Filter, Not the Message: Node-Channel Mixtures for Pre-Propagation GNNs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01660)
*Zichao Yue,Zhiru Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FilterMoE，一种混合专家预传播图神经网络，通过3D门控张量在节点和通道维度上联合路由可学习的切比雪夫滤波器专家，解决了PPGNN中节点自适应与通道自适应滤波缺失的问题，在多个基准测试中取得最优结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有预传播图神经网络（PPGNNs）中，复杂的跳数聚合器并不比简单的MLP聚合器更可靠，这一谜题促使作者从图滤波器视角重新审视。作者发现现有PPGNN设计存在缺失区域：在预传播计算约束下，缺少节点与通道联合自适应滤波的机制。

Method: 提出FilterMoE，采用混合专家架构，包含一个小型可学习的切比雪夫滤波器专家库，通过3D门控张量在节点和通道两个维度上联合路由，实现预传播条件下的节点-通道联合自适应滤波。

Result: 在11个同质性和异质性基准上，FilterMoE在9个数据集上超越强PPGNN基线，在所有三个大规模基准上排名第一，平均测试分数提升1.53分。

Conclusion: 联合节点-通道滤波器路由可以作为数据集特定的跳数聚合器选择的鲁棒替代方案，为PPGNN设计提供了新范式。

Abstract: Pre-propagation graph neural networks (PPGNNs) push all graph-dependent computation into a preprocessing step and train only on the resulting dense hop features, which makes them highly scalable. A puzzle in this regime is that more complex hop aggregators do not reliably outperform simpler ones: on many benchmarks, a plain MLP-based aggregator matches or beats hop-attention variants. We revisit this behavior from a graph-filter perspective. Over a precomputed diffusion basis, existing PPGNNs differ mainly in how filter coefficients are shared across nodes and feature channels, rather than simply in raw aggregator capacity. MLP-based architectures learn channel-dependent filters that are largely shared across nodes, while hop-attention-based architectures learn node-dependent mixtures that are largely shared across channels. This reveals a missing regime in standard PPGNN designs: joint node- and channel-adaptive filtering under the pre-propagation computational contract. We propose FilterMoE, a mixture-of-experts PPGNN in which a small bank of learnable Chebyshev filter experts is routed jointly over nodes and channels by a 3D gating tensor. Across eleven homophilic and heterophilic benchmarks, FilterMoE outperforms strong PPGNN baselines on nine datasets and ranks first on all three large-scale benchmarks, improving the average test score by 1.53 points. These results establish joint node-channel filter routing as a robust alternative to dataset-specific hop-aggregator selection.

</details>


### [457] [Quantifying the Energy Floor: Direct Measurement and Replay Buffer Bias in SAC-Based HVAC Control on sbsim](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.01665)
*Bo Li,Chen Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究量化了SAC算法在建筑HVAC控制中的能量下限（35.51美元/天），发现标准SAC（37.18美元/天）高出4.7%，其主要次优性源于缓冲区初始化（空缓冲区训练可消除96%的差距）。同时揭示了折扣因子耦合问题（有效规划周期从8.3小时缩至46分钟），并证明设备最小功率而非算法设计是主要约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
